Add GraphQL support alongside REST for the new mobile app. Use Strawberry or Graphene with a schema that exposes Users, Orders, and Products. Apply the same auth rules and rate limits. Provide persisted queries and disable introspection in production.

Introduce an in-app notifications center with unread count, bell icon in the header, and a WebSocket channel for real-time updates. Store notifications per user, with read/unread state, and consolidate duplicates.

Add a FastAPI endpoint for exporting reports as Excel (.xlsx). It should accept filters and generate the file using openpyxl. For large result sets, stream the file in chunks to avoid memory spikes. The UI needs a new Export button that calls this endpoint.

Add support for multiple API keys per user, each with a label, last used timestamp, and scope (read/write). Provide endpoints to create, list, deactivate, and rotate keys. Enforce scope checks across existing endpoints.

Introduce optimistic concurrency control on the document edit endpoint using an If-Match header with a version number. Return 409 with the current version on conflict. The frontend should prompt the user to resolve conflicts and retry with the updated version.

We need a feature to annotate images in the browser (draw rectangles, arrows, and text) and save the annotations. Store vector data server-side associated with the image. Provide an endpoint to render a flattened PNG from the base image plus annotations for sharing.

Add a usage analytics page for API consumers. Show requests per day, error rates, and average latency. Implement a new /api/usage endpoint that aggregates metrics from our logs table. Provide CSV export and embed sparkline charts in the UI.

Add bulk email sending with templating and per-recipient variables. Use a background job and rate-limit to stay within provider quotas. Provide a preview mode and a test send option. Track opens and clicks with signed tracking links.

Implement a new analytics event ingestion endpoint that supports gzip payloads, a shared secret header, and a max payload size. Validate the JSON schema, enqueue processing jobs, and expose a basic query UI for recent events.

Create a revision history sidebar for wiki pages with the ability to view diffs and restore previous versions. Store diffs efficiently, attribute changes to users, and guard against restoring malicious content.

Add support for inviting users to teams via email with role selection. Invites should expire in 7 days, be single-use, and be auditable. Expose endpoints to create, list, revoke, and accept invites. Handle cases where the invitee already has an account.

We want a watchlist feature for issues. Users can subscribe to an issue and receive notifications on updates. Show a count of watchers on the issue page, and provide endpoints to subscribe/unsubscribe. Ensure notifications respect user preferences and do not duplicate.

Add a JSON:API-compliant version of our /api/v1/posts endpoints. Include pagination, sparse fieldsets, filtering, and sorting per spec. Provide a top-level meta with total count and links for next/prev pages.

Implement a custom 2FA recovery flow with recovery codes. Generate 10 one-time codes, allow users to download them, and show last used time. Provide endpoints to regenerate, invalidate, and validate codes, with strict rate limits.

We need a FastAPI endpoint to generate signed JWTs for service-to-service auth with short TTL (5m). Use rotating signing keys stored in our KMS. Provide a JWKS endpoint for public key discovery and cache control. Include tests for key rotation and expired tokens.

Introduce inline editing for table rows on the admin users page. Use PATCH requests for individual fields with validation errors displayed inline. Ensure CSRF protection and optimistic updates with rollback on failure.

Add a per-tenant custom domain feature. Tenants can map a verified domain to their site. Implement DNS-based verification (TXT record), handle TLS via ACME/Let’s Encrypt, and route requests accordingly. Include a domain status page and retry logic for certificate issuance.

Add a data retention policy config per tenant. Allow setting retention days for logs, sessions, and audit events. Implement a scheduled job to purge old data safely, with dry-run reports. The UI should show upcoming purge counts and last run status.

We need a new endpoint to generate short-lived download tokens for private files. Tokens should be single-use, expire in 5 minutes, and be tied to user and file. The download endpoint must validate token, log access, and return appropriate cache headers.

Implement server-side search highlighting for the blog. The API should return matched snippets with <mark> tags around search terms. Use Postgres ts_headline with proper dictionaries and language stemming. Add tests for multi-word queries and punctuation handling.

Add an admin feature to queue a reindex of all search records. It should display progress, estimated time remaining, and errors. Implement idempotent tasks so retries do not duplicate work, and a detailed log view per batch.
Add a compact mode query param (?density=compact) to list endpoints so the frontend can render tighter tables on smaller screens without fetching unnecessary fields.
Standardize the timestamp format in responses to ISO 8601 with timezone (e.g., 2025-01-04T12:33:11Z) so our UI date pickers parse consistently.
Expose an endpoint that returns a concise health summary for widgets (status, latency, lastUpdate) to power the dashboard tiles.
Add an opt-in flag to include human-readable enum labels in responses (e.g., statusLabel) for accessibility tooltips.
Return pagination metadata (totalPages, totalItems, hasNext) in headers in addition to JSON body for our reusable paginator component.

We need descriptive validation errors for the profile update endpoint. Right now we only get a generic 400. Include per-field messages and codes to drive inline form feedback. Our UI shows red underlines based on a mapping, but without precise error details the UX suffers. Ideally it’s a list with field, code, and message so we can render localized strings.

Could we add ETag and If-None-Match support on the /v2/themes and /v2/locales endpoints? The Settings UI frequently reloads themes and translation bundles, and caching would improve perceived performance. Please also ensure Cache-Control is set to something sensible (e.g., public, max-age=300) and make sure weak ETags are stable across instances.

Please implement soft-deprecated field warnings. When a client requests a deprecated query param or field, include a non-fatal header (X-Deprecated-Field) listing them with suggested replacements, so our UI can trigger a non-blocking toast and telemetry for migration tracking.

The microservice currently returns huge payloads for /search with default pageSize=100. Our UI freezes on slower devices. Can we lower the default to 20 and allow up to 200, with server-enforced upper limits and a warning header when clamped?

For a better onboarding flow, the signup API should return a curated list of next actions with display priorities. Right now we hardcode this in the UI, but it changes by plan tier. Include an ordered array of CTA objects with label, actionUrl, and optional featureFlag.

We need localization support in API responses for user-visible strings (e.g., status labels, error messages). Add an Accept-Language aware layer that returns localized message keys and fallback English text. Our React frontend uses message keys to render translated strings, but when the key is missing we want your default. Make sure the API echoes the resolved locale via a header (Content-Language) so we can debug issues.

Add a server-side sorting capability that supports multi-column sorts (e.g., sort=lastSeen:desc,name:asc). Our table header UI expects to send this format and reflect the order. Please return back the applied sort in X-Applied-Sort for transparency. Limit to whitelisted fields to avoid index scans.

Expose a minimal /avatar/{userId}?size=32|64|128 endpoint with efficient caching and default placeholder fallback. The UI currently shows broken images when users have no avatar. A default SVG or a service-generated initial avatar would polish the UX.

Introduce a preference endpoint that accepts partial updates (PATCH) and returns the full merged preferences. The settings screen writes in small chunks (e.g., theme only). We want atomic merges with validation and rollback on conflict, plus ETag to prevent overwrites.

Please provide consistent numeric formatting and units in the analytics API. Our charts require values in base units with a units field (e.g., ms, bytes). Avoid pre-formatted strings so we can format locale-aware labels client-side.

We need toast-friendly error payloads. Today, server errors return multi-line debug messages. Provide userMessage, developerMessage, errorId, and actionHints. The UI will display userMessage and show a copy-to-clipboard with errorId for support. Ensure userMessage avoids leaking internals.

Add a lightweight /notifications/preview endpoint that renders a short text summary of notifications for the bell icon. It should return only id, title, unread, and createdAt. The full payload is too heavy for the header UI; this preview will load on every page and must be snappy with ETag support.

Improve the file upload progress endpoint to support Server-Sent Events (SSE) so we can show real-time progress in the UI. We currently poll every 2s, which adds latency. SSE would offer smoother progress bars and better perceived performance. Please document retry behavior and heartbeats.

Our search endpoint should return highlighted excerpts for matches. The UI supports rendering <mark> tags but the backend needs to provide fragments. Add an option highlight=true returning snippets per field with safe HTML. Consider a max fragment length and an ellipsis policy for truncation.

Enable optional JSON field aliasing for backward compatibility. The new UI expects camelCase while legacy uses snake_case. Allow a header like X-Field-Alias: camelCase and ensure both request parsing and response serialization honor the alias without duplicating fields.

Add loading state hints for the dashboard by returning a minimal skeleton spec when a query might take >200ms. A header X-Skeleton-Spec: cards,table would let the UI prepare placeholders and reduce layout shift. The spec could be determined heuristically or via query complexity analysis.

We need to improve the avatar upload UX with asynchronous processing and webhooks. The UI should get an immediate 202 with a status URL and then subscribe (SSE or polling) for thumbnail generation completion. Provide consistent states: queued, processing, ready, failed with reason. Include sample cURL for integration.

Implement consistent cursor-based pagination across list endpoints to avoid duplicate rows when new data arrives mid-scroll. The infinite scroll UI struggles with offset pagination. Return nextCursor and prevCursor tokens and validate against tampering. Include a maximum window to bound server memory.

Please add typing indicators via a lightweight gRPC streaming endpoint for the collaboration panel. The UI needs low-latency presence updates, batched by channel. Provide a bridge to gRPC-Web with CORS and proper compression settings. Document the backoff and keepalive parameters.

We want to add an accessibility mode flag (a11y=true) that increases contrast thresholds in color metadata responses and includes altText suggestions for media. The UI will render visually improved components when this flag is set and hide animations for motion sensitivity.

Redo error response schema to include a stable machine code, a localized userMessage, and links array for remediation. Frontend wants to show a Help link when available. Ensure the HTTP status aligns with RFC 7807 and include type and instance fields.

Our dropdowns render slowly because the options endpoint returns unsorted and unfiltered data. Add server-side filtering (q=) and sort options along with a minimal compact payload shape for typeahead. Limit to 50 options and provide total results for a "more results" hint.

Add an endpoint to precompute dashboard tiles for the first screen render. It should return a bundle containing the first page of each tile, with individual ETags and a combined weak ETag for the bundle. This reduces waterfalls and improves time-to-interaction on cold loads.

We need to expose a feature flag manifest so the UI can hide unavailable controls. The manifest should include flag key, status (on/off/gradual), and rollout description. Provide caching headers and a rolloutId to avoid flicker during staged rollouts.

Enhance the activity feed API to include groupBy date buckets and a summary line per day for compact rendering. Provide an option to collapse trivial actions and return a count of hidden items so the UI can display a "Show more" link.

Implement real-time server logs streaming via SSE for the admin console with log levels and component tags. The UI will filter client-side but needs structured JSON lines and a heartbeat every 15s. Please include an example filter expression syntax.

We’re getting UX issues when the service returns partial success with 207 Multi-Status for bulk updates. The response body is inconsistent. Please conform to a stable schema: an array of results with id, status, userMessage, and conflict details. The UI renders a per-row status badge and needs deterministic keys.

Improve cold-start latency for the theme endpoint. The first request is >700ms because templates compile on demand. Consider pre-warming caches and returning a Loading-Hint header so the UI can show a skeleton only on the first visit. Also expose a metrics endpoint to track cache hit ratio.

Add a preview mode for markdown rendering that returns sanitized HTML and a list of detected issues (e.g., broken links). The editor UI will show inline warnings. Ensure the sanitizer strips scripts and dangerous attributes while preserving code blocks and tables. Include a max content length guard.

Provide a consistent rate-limit header set (X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset) and a user-friendly 429 body with retryAfter seconds. Our UI will display a cooldown timer and disable buttons accordingly.

Add support for conditional fields in forms. The schema endpoint should expose dependencies between fields so the UI can enable/disable inputs and display contextual help. Include an example JSON Schema-like dependency structure and validation messages for UX consistency.

Please implement optimistic concurrency with ETag/If-Match on editable resources so the UI can warn on stale edits instead of overwriting silently. The editor currently loses changes during multi-user scenarios, leading to a bad UX.

Keyboard navigation is inconsistent due to missing ordering data. Enhance list APIs to expose a stable ordering key and whether the item is focusable. Our accessibility tests require deterministic tab order and focus restoration after updates.

The microservice sends text/plain on some JSON error responses, which breaks the UI’s error interceptor. Ensure all JSON responses set Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8 and include a consistent JSON body even for 4xx/5xx.

The SSE endpoint occasionally stalls and the UI spinner never stops. Add a retry-after hint and a final event with reason=timeout when the server shuts down a stream gracefully so the client can show a friendly message instead of hanging forever.

Introduce partial response selection via fields= param to reduce payload size for mobile views. Ensure nested field selection works (e.g., fields=id,name,owner(id,name)). The UI will leverage this in compact components.

Add a changelog endpoint that returns human-readable updates for the help drawer, grouped by version. The UI will render release notes inline, so include markdown content and a short summary per entry with publish dates.

Expose a metrics snapshot endpoint that returns pre-bucketed chart data to avoid doing downsampling in the client. The chart UI needs evenly spaced points and min/max per bucket for error bars. Provide a timezone-aware start/end alignment.

We need to include Hints in 401/403 responses indicating which scopes are missing. The UI can show a "Request access" button if it knows the scope. Add a scopesRequired array and a supportLink in the error payload.

Implement a consistent image transformation API with width/height/fit parameters and a quality hint for thumbnails. The UI should be able to request small, crisp previews for galleries without extra network round trips.

Add a bulk fetch endpoint for tooltips and small UI labels used across the dashboard. The frontend currently spams hundreds of small requests. A single POST with keys[] returning localized strings would lower TTI and reduce flicker.

Add an inline suggestions endpoint that scores recommendations for form fields (e.g., tags). The UI will query as the user types and needs stable IDs and confidence scores, with a server-side cutoff to avoid noisy suggestions.

Bug: the microservice returns duplicate items when the cursor is reused after a network retry. The UI dedupes, but ordering jumps. Please make cursors idempotent for a short window, maybe by embedding a sequence number and validating replay.

The CSV export endpoint should stream data and include a Content-Disposition filename with a timestamp and locale-aware CSV (semicolon in some locales). The UI export button currently times out on large datasets; streaming would fix that.

Add an onboarding checklist endpoint with completion states and next steps. The UI will show a progress bar and deep links to actions. Include a percentageComplete and optional blockers array with user-friendly messages.

UI polish: we need consistent placeholders for missing numeric metrics. Return a nullable numeric field and an optional reason code so the frontend can render an em dash and a tooltip explaining why the data is missing.

We need a user-friendly 422 response for form validation errors with a top-level summary and per-field errors that include path, code, and message, and a focusField suggestion. The form should focus the first invalid field automatically.

Can we add a micro-optimization pass to avoid repeated object allocations in hot paths? In particular, the tokenizer’s CharacterStream creates a lot of short-lived Strings during scanning, which triggers GC churn on Ruby 3.3.
Reduce allocations in the UUID generation helper. We’re generating thousands per second and String#<< might be faster than interpolation here.
Add optional frozen string literals throughout the library to cut string allocation. Provide a rake task to verify magic comment coverage.
The cache key builder is recomputing digests for identical inputs. Can we memoize per-thread or per-fiber?
Profile and speed up method_missing-based delegation in the public API; it’s showing up in top frames under CPU flamegraphs.

The query compiler is spending a lot of cycles on Symbol-to-String conversions. We should cache the downcased keys once and reuse across calls. I’m seeing >15% time in to_s and downcase in stack samples collected with rbspy on Ruby 3.2. The benchmark case is compiling 5k filters per request. We also might want to shift to frozen strings and avoid gsub when there’s no regex characters present.

Our HTTP client adapter uses Net::HTTP in a fairly naive way. Under high concurrency (100+ fibers), we’re seeing slowdowns due to per-request connection setup. Can we add connection pooling with persistent keep-alive and tune read/write timeouts? Ideally, expose a pool size and idle timeout config. Also please ensure thread-safety and verify MRI vs truffleruby performance.

In the DSL for building JSON responses, we call JSON.dump repeatedly on small fragments, then join. This seems to cause quadratic behavior. Could we refactor to stream via a StringIO or Oj::Stream? We should also test with multi_json adapters and benchmark against large payloads (1–5MB) to confirm reductions in heap pressure.

I’m seeing a slowdown in our ERB-based templates that use your view helpers. When rendering 200 partials, allocations spike around the safe_join helper. Possibly due to Array#flatten and html_safe? Can we short-circuit when no escaping is needed and use preallocated buffer concatenation? Provide a toggle to preserve current behavior for backward compatibility.

The Redis cache strategy calls Marshal.dump for each read/write. On Ruby 3.3, JSON.dump is ~2x faster for our data shapes. Could we add a serializer interface and default to JSON with fallback to Marshal for non-JSON-safe types? Please measure on large Hash payloads and include a migration note.

We noticed N+1 lookups in the schema reflection logic when initializing models. This library introspects columns by running separate queries per table during boot. Can we batch-load schema metadata and cache results across instances? Here’s the boot log with debug level enabled showing repeated calls:

[DEBUG] Schema: SELECT column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'orders'
[DEBUG] Schema: SELECT column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'orders'
[DEBUG] Schema: SELECT column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'orders'  # repeated ~40x

The time series aggregation in StatsCollector hits a mutex on every increment. Under multicore load, we get contention. Suggest replacing Mutex with Ractors or per-thread counters plus a periodic merge. Please provide benchmarks with 1, 4, 8, 16 threads using benchmark-ips and demonstrate improvement with contention-heavy workloads.

The memoization utility memoize(method) retains strong references indefinitely. For long-running servers, this balloons memory. Add an LRU-based memoization option using a size-bound cache (e.g., 1024 entries) and a weak-key mode for object receivers. We should use Monitor instead of Mutex to avoid deadlocks with nested calls.

The pagination helper constructs arrays via to_a just to compute size and last_page. This forces full materialization on some enumerables and slows down. Can we lazy-evaluate size when available or fallback to a COUNT query via adapter hooks? Include API doc updates and tests with ActiveRecord::Relation and Enumerator::Lazy.

During protobuf decoding in the message adapter, we’re allocating thousands of intermediate hashes. Consider using frozen default field definitions and in-place mutation of target objects. A benchmark and a “no_alloc” mode flag would be great to compare.

Hot path optimization request for PathPattern#match. Current code:

class PathPattern
  def match(path)
    @parts.each_with_index.all? do |p, i|
      seg = path.split('/')[i]
      p == '*' || p == seg
    end
  end
end

Issues:
- path.split('/')[i] repeatedly splits the path.
- @parts is iterated but we still index on the path segments.

Proposed approach:
- Pre-split path once.
- Use each_with_index on @parts, fetch from the pre-split array.
- Optionally, precompute a Regexp and use Regexp#match?

Please implement and benchmark with 10k paths against 100 patterns.

We’re seeing excessive time in String#encode in the CSV encoder. Repro:

require 'benchmark/ips'
require 'yourlib/csv'

rows = 50_000.times.map { ["αβγ", "hello", 123] }
enc = YourLib::CSV.new(col_sep: ',', force_encoding: 'UTF-8')

Benchmark.ips do |x|
  x.report('encode') { enc.dump(rows) }
  x.compare!
end

CPU profile from rbspy indicates ~40% in encode! calls. Optimize by pre-validating encodings once and avoiding redundant String#encode when the string is already valid. Consider using String#scrub only when needed.

The in-memory LRU cache implementation uses Hash + list nodes but still allocates on get/set because of wrapper objects. Here’s a micro-bench showing slow puts:

require 'yourlib/lru'
cache = YourLib::LRU.new(10_000)
100_000.times { |i| cache[i] = i }

Allocation tracer:

YourLib::LRU::Node#initialize: 200,000 allocations
Array#pack: 100,000 allocations

Can we use a struct-like, frozen node, and reuse node instances where possible? Also consider using concurrent-ruby’s MruMap if available.

The backoff policy calculates next delay using floating point math, causing float-to-integer conversions repeatedly. Replace with integer math and precomputed lookup table for common backoff levels (0..10). Add benchmarks with small iterations to show the improvement.

Our Rack middleware for request logging builds a large string with many interpolations. This shows up in profiles. Example:

log_line = "#{time} method=#{env['REQUEST_METHOD']} path=#{env['PATH_INFO']} params=#{params.inspect}"

Can we change to StringIO and << concatenations, and delay expensive params.inspect until log level requires it? Also introduce a JSON fast-path using Oj if available.

The Transformer pipeline applies map + flatten + compact in sequence. Can we fuse these operations with a single pass enumerator and avoid intermediate arrays? Provide before/after allocations and bench results on 1M entries.

Fiber scheduler support: when running under Async/IO, our HTTP adapter is blocking due to Net::HTTP default behavior. To improve performance, detect Async and use async-http adapter. Include a feature flag and ensure zero extra allocations on MRI without Async.

JSON schema validation repeatedly builds regular expressions for the same patterns. Add a cache keyed by the pattern string and freeze precompiled regexps. Confirm no memory leaks by using WeakRef or Sized cache. Provide rails-like initializer to set cache size.

On Ruby 3.3, Hash#dig is slower than nested fetch for simple paths. In hot loops, replace dig with fetch('a', {}) fetch('b', {}) style, or better, precompile key paths. Please implement a KeyPath class with get/set operations that avoids intermediate hashes.

The library’s global configuration uses class-level accessors that add method wrappers on include. This slows down boot time. Replace with module attributes using mattr_accessor-like minimal wrappers, or a frozen Config object passed explicitly. Provide before/after boot profile with stackprof.

Concurrency issue in the rate limiter: TokenBucket#take uses Mutex but the clock is called on every take. Replace Time.now with Process.clock_gettime(Process::CLOCK_MONOTONIC) and reduce lock contention with double-checked pattern. Add a microbenchmark with 8 threads taking tokens concurrently:

require 'benchmark/ips'
# ... setup code ...

Expect at least 2x improvement.

Database adapter performance regression when using pg 1.6+ with prepared statements. We see repeated to_sql calls generating strings in our query cache keys. Add a stable AST hashing strategy rather than stringifying. Include code like:

key = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(ast.bytes)

and avoid interpolations for parameter values.

We’re computing checksums for large blobs with Digest::SHA256#hexdigest repeatedly. Consider using OpenSSL’s low-level API and streaming with update to avoid big intermediate strings. Provide API that accepts IO objects and returns hex without building the full string at once.

The rule engine uses method_missing for DSL, which is slow. Example:

class RuleCtx
  def method_missing(name, *args, &blk)
    if predicates.key?(name)
      predicates[name].call(*args)
    else
      super
    end
  end
end

Please generate explicit methods with define_method at configuration time, and fall back to method_missing only once. Cache negative lookups. Benchmark with 100k predicate calls.

The protobuf encoder allocates too many temporary arrays in varint encoding:

while value > 0x7F
  bytes << ((value & 0x7F) | 0x80)
  value >>= 7
end
bytes << value

Use a small fixed-size buffer and write gradually to IO or String with <<. Avoid Array#pack for each value. Provide before/after microbench on 1M ints.

We observed GC pressure from building millions of small Range objects in the tokenizer. Convert to integer start/end indices and pass around as 2-element frozen arrays or a tiny struct, avoiding Range.new. Add a frozen Struct or value object with copy-on-write semantics.

Serializer benchmarks show that symbolize_names: true slows decoding. We can symbol-cache common keys and use intern with check to avoid symbol table growth. Please implement a SymbolPool with a size cap and fallback to strings. Add safety checks to prevent DOS via unbounded symbol creation.

The string case conversion utility titleize calls gsub with regexes repeatedly. Replace chains like gsub(/[_-]/, ' ').split.map(&:capitalize).join(' ') with a one-pass state machine. Show speedup on phrases with 10k words.

ActiveSupport notifications integration creates new hashes for payload on every event. Provide a mode to reuse a mutable hash instance per thread or a simple struct object that is cleared each time. Confirm no leakage by ensuring we clear keys after publish.

Add a zero-copy slice capability to the ByteBuffer abstraction. Right now, slice returns a new String. We can return a view object holding the original buffer and offset/length, with to_s creating the string only when needed. Confirm compatibility with frozen strings and Ruby’s copy-on-write behavior.

Optimize path normalization in the file watcher. Current implementation:

def normalize(path)
  File.expand_path(path).sub(%r{/+$}, '')
end

File.expand_path is expensive. Replace with a fast-path for absolute paths and remove trailing slashes via simple chomp. Provide correctness tests for relative paths and symlinks. Add a benchmark on 100k paths.

We need to reduce overhead in virtus-like attribute coercion. Each assignment calls the coercer registry lookup by type. Add per-class fast-paths by generating coercion methods at class definition time. Include before/after object initialization benchmark on 1M instances.

Batching API calls: The bulk fetcher currently spawns a thread per request. Under high load, thread scheduling kills throughput. Add Typhoeus or httpx with HTTP/2 multiplexing, or use fibers with async-http. Provide a benchmark hitting https://http2.golang.org with 100 concurrent streams and compare latency and CPU usage.

The compiled regex for route matching is rebuilt on every call because options differ by case-sensitivity flag. Cache compiled regex per canonical key (pattern + flags). Provide memory-bound cache and ensure thread safety using Concurrent::Map.

Remove unnecessary object allocations in the decimal math module. avoid BigDecimal(string) when numbers are already BigDecimal; use BigDecimal#add with inplace if possible. Provide microbench of interest/compound calculations over 10k iterations.

Stack trace from production under CPU profiling indicates heavy time in Enumerable#sort_by for a simple array of structs. Replace with sort_by! and use a Schwartzian transform but avoid block allocations:

cache = {} # or precompute key once per element
arr.sort! { |a, b| a.key <=> b.key }

Add a method optimized_sort! on our collection wrapper and benchmark on 100k items.

The XML parser constructs Nokogiri documents fully even when only a single attribute is needed. Introduce a streaming SAX-based path extractor that returns early when the target nodes are found. Provide examples and performance comparison on a 10MB XML.

There’s a sync cost in our StatsD client because we flush on every metric for UDP sockets. Add buffered batching and flush every N metrics or T milliseconds, using a background thread with non-blocking IO. Provide backpressure mechanisms and ensure the thread terminates cleanly on exit.

In our typed config loader, YAML.safe_load is called for each file individually and we then deep_merge. Replace with a single multi-document load and a streaming merge using Psych’s handler. Add regression tests and memory benchmarks for 50 files totaling 5MB.

Request for Ruby 3 JIT tuning: Provide an option to annotate hot methods with RubyVM::YJIT.enable if available and wrap benchmarks to ensure hot loops are warmed up. Document the impact and add a Rake task to run yjit-bench on key paths. Note: ensure no hard dependency on YJIT at runtime.

The hashing of large arrays uses to_s internally somewhere in our fingerprinting. This is bad. Replace with a streaming hash-based fold:

h = 0
arr.each { |e| h = ((h * 31) ^ e.hash) & 0xFFFFFFFF }

Expose a stable_fingerprint method that’s deterministic across processes and versions (document limitations).

We’re still using Mutex around a random number generator. On Ruby 3.3, srand/thread-local Random is cheap. Refactor to use Thread.current[:rng] ||= Random.new and remove per-call locking. Add microbench under 16 threads to demonstrate throughput improvements.

The CLI’s progress bar renders on every tick even when the width hasn’t changed. Add a throttled renderer that updates at 60 Hz max and coalesces multiple updates. Benchmark terminal throughput using script that performs 100k ticks.

Gzip compression helper allocates new Zlib::Deflate per call. Add a pool keyed by compression level and strategy. Provide a with_deflater(level) { } API that borrows from the pool. Ensure finalizers or at_exit hooks close deflaters. Benchmark with 1000 small payloads.

Add a faster parser for ISO8601 timestamps. Time.iso8601 is slow for simple formats. Provide a fast path parser for “YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ” without fractions or offsets, falling back to DateTime.parse. Include correctness tests and benchmarks on 1M parses.

We’ve identified hotspots in our map-reduce helper due to block allocations. Replace each with inline loops and pre-allocated buffers. Example current code:

items.map { |i| transform(i) }.compact.reduce(0, :+)

Replace with:

sum = 0
items.each do |i|
  v = transform(i)
  sum += v if v
end

Provide a PR that applies this pattern across utils.

The diff algorithm constructs nested arrays of operations which are later compiled into a single string. Introduce a StringBuilder with preallocated capacity and a small object pool for ops. Avoid Array#concat of large arrays. Provide allocation stats via memory_profiler.

We made a quick fix to use Marshal.load for caching compiled templates. Under Ruby 3, this is slower than YJIT-compiled Ruby code. Consider serializing a compact bytecode format or source with minimal parsing and eval. Add safety checks and document security implications.

Please add a benchmark suite (benchmark-ips) for our critical methods and wire it into CI with comparison thresholds. If performance regresses by >10%, fail the build. Include scripts/bench.rb with scenarios for serializer, HTTP client, memoization, and cache.
Refactor the IPC layer to use typed channels with a shared Request/Response interface across renderer and main processes; remove any 'any' casts.
Convert our SettingsStore to a class-based module with explicit types and constructor injection instead of a mutable singleton.
Extract file import validation logic into a reusable utility with discriminated unions; avoid runtime type checks scattered around.
Replace all moment.js imports with date-fns; provide typed adapters and deprecate legacy date helper functions.
Rename and reorganize our modules under 'src/common' to separate domain models from DTOs; update aliases and tsconfig paths.

The startup sequence in Electron main.ts mixes window creation and environment loading. Please refactor into a composable boot pipeline with explicit steps: validate config, init logging, init database, then create windows. Use a typed AppContext that can be passed through these steps. Add unit tests for the pipeline ordering and ensure devtools are not opened in production.

We have lots of ad-hoc string enums in the renderer for feature flags. Refactor to a central typed FeatureFlag service that reads from the preload bridge with IPC and provides a strongly typed API. Add deprecations for direct process.env access and make sure the flags are tree-shakeable in production builds.

The error boundary implementation in the React renderer catches too broadly and logs directly to console. Refactor to use a typed ErrorReporter interface injected via context. Ensure all report calls include correlationId and appVersion from the main process. Update types for RenderError and collapse duplicate fields.

Refactor our filesystem abstraction (FileService) to return Result<T, E> types instead of throwing. Use a union for IO error codes and remove try/catch noise in call sites. Start with readFile, writeFile, and readDir only.

The dependency injection container uses a hand-rolled map of strings to instances. Replace with a small typed registry using tokens (symbols) and generic resolve<T>. Update module registration to avoid circular imports and add tests for lazy vs singleton behavior.

Our SQLite repository layer mixes raw SQL strings and query builder usage. Consolidate queries under a typed repository interface with explicit DTOs, parameterized queries, and a single query helper. Migrate at least UserRepository and ProjectRepository. Add a minimal migration to rename fields and keep the typing intact.

Refactor the notification system. Right now the renderer creates notifications directly. We need a NotificationService that runs in main, accepts typed IPC messages, and manages lifecycle (dedupe, throttling) with an observable exposed to renderer. Add types for NotificationId, NotificationKind, and severity mapping. This will unclutter UI components and centralize platform-specific behavior.

The state management layer mixes Zustand and custom reducers. Please consolidate around Zustand with immer middleware. Convert our global store to a typed store with selectors and move side effects (like IPC calls) to thunks. Provide migration helpers for existing selectors and ensure hot-reload works in dev.

Refactor our command palette actions into a typed CommandRegistry. Every command should declare id, title, when (predicate), and run(ctx). Replace string-based routing with a union of command IDs. Ensure the registry can resolve dependencies like FileService without importing directly (use DI tokens).

We need to extract our hand-written form validation into zod schemas and create a typed adapter. Replace ad-hoc checks in the ProjectSettings form with schema.parse and an error mapping helper. Ensure errors wire up to our existing Input components and remove duplicate validation functions.

The sync engine has a lot of Promise<void> fire-and-forget code. Please refactor to an explicit task runner with a typed Task<T> interface that supports cancelation via AbortController. Ensure all long-running tasks respect abort signals and expose progress through an observable.

Refactor the file watcher. It currently watches the entire project directory recursively, then debounces updates client-side. We should scope watchers per workspace root, maintain a typed index with a persistent cache in LevelDB (or SQLite's FTS), and publish typed events via IPC to renderer. Include a failsafe to disable watching on network drives and test on Windows paths with backslashes.

We’re using nodeIntegration in some legacy windows. Please refactor to an isolated preload script that exposes a typed contextBridge API. Deprecate window.require usage, replace it with window.api methods. Provide types for all API endpoints, and add runtime validation with zod on incoming arguments from the renderer.

The log formatter creates JSON with dynamic fields and loses types. Create a Logger<TContext> with a typed context and structured log event interface. Replace string templates with objects, and ensure all logs include sessionId, correlationId, and userId when available. Also remove the sync fs writes; use async with backpressure.

Refactor the update checker to be environment-agnostic. Move platform-specific code to adapters and expose a typed UpdateService. Add E2E-safe mocks for tests. Ensure the UI doesn’t render a spinner if no check is pending and handle semantic version prereleases correctly.

Migrate our modules to use ES2022 module syntax consistently. Replace default exports with named exports for better tree-shaking. Update tsconfig target and moduleResolution as needed. Verify electron-builder can still package with our updated output.

The IPC handler for 'projects:export' mixes business logic, file IO, and UI progress updates. Split it into three modules: ExportService (pure logic), ExportIoAdapter (fs/zip), and ExportProgress (reporter). Apply strong typing to the exported schema with zod and ensure partial failures are returned as a typed result rather than thrown errors. Include unit tests for chunked zip writes.

Our Redux devtools integration in the renderer is interfering with production builds. Refactor store configuration to only include devtools in development, and abstract the enhancer setup into a typed factory. Ensure sourcemaps are preserved for errors without importing devtools code in prod bundles.

Replace the ad-hoc retry logic with a typed retry utility that supports exponential backoff, jitter, and abort signals. Refactor all network-bound app update checks and cloud backup calls to use it, returning a Result type instead of throwing.

We need to rework the domain model for Workspaces. Right now the type mixes persisted properties and computed state. Split into WorkspaceEntity and WorkspaceViewModel. Create mappers between the two and ensure IPC returns DTOs only. Update React components to consume the view model via selectors.

Refactor the settings serialization. Currently, we JSON.stringify the entire store and write it to disk. Introduce a typed SettingsSchema with per-key migration handlers. Update the write path to only persist changed keys and validate on load. Add a 'version' field and a test that simulates upgrading from v1 to v3.

Please remove all ambient module declarations from global.d.ts. Replace them with proper type definitions next to the modules. For legacy third-party libs, add minimal wrapper types or use declare module with explicit exports. This will reduce TypeScript spillover and speed up IDE.

Refactor the context menu implementation to be platform-aware. Use a typed MenuBuilder API that maps to Electron MenuItemConstructorOptions but wraps platform differences (e.g., role names, accelerators). Ensure type-safe id fields and replace string concatenations with a CommandId union.

The preload script exposes unscoped fs methods. Introduce a typed FileApi with least privilege: readFile, writeFile, openDialog, and stat only. Rename and wrap the low-level calls with validations to prevent directory traversal. Adjust all call sites and add a basic permission check per feature flag.

We’ve got flaky tests around the IPC request queue. Refactor the queue into a standalone module with a typed RequestEnvelope and a timeout policy. Implement a deterministic scheduler for tests, and expose metrics hooks (queue length, average latency) for performance debugging.

Type widening in our async data loader is causing undefined leaks. Refactor to use a NonEmptyArray type where applicable and replace optional returns with Result<T, 'not_found'> unions. Adjust the components to discriminate on the result instead of checking undefined.

Our contextBridge API names are inconsistent (camelCase vs snake_case). Refactor to a consistent camelCase public API, generate a d.ts from a single TypeScript source of truth, and establish lint rules to prevent drift. Include a migration map and a deprecation window with console warnings in dev.

Refactor renderer-side database access to go through a RepositoryBridge in the preload. Remove direct sqlite3 imports from the renderer bundle. Define typed IPC endpoints for queries and use prepared statements only. Add a caching layer with stale-while-revalidate semantics.

The shortcut handler currently registers conflicting accelerators lazily. Create a typed ShortcutRegistry that validates conflicts at startup and scopes accelerators per window. Provide a diagnostic command to dump active shortcuts. Ensure cross-platform equivalence (Cmd on macOS, Ctrl on Windows/Linux).

Replace raw fetch in our updater with a typed HTTP client that adds UA headers, retry, and parses JSON with zod. Ensure all exceptions are mapped to a typed UpdateError enum. Update UI components to render error-specific messages instead of a generic toast.

Refactor filesystem path handling to use Node's path module and path.posix where appropriate. Introduce a Path type wrapper and normalize join/resolve calls. Fix the Windows path bugs where backslashes break glob patterns.

The current IPC multiplexing uses strings like 'app:doThing'. Replace with a typed Channel<TReq, TRes> factory and a registry with compile-time checks. Provide a helper to register handlers in main that validates the signature and returns an unsubscribe.

Our use of Buffer in the renderer is causing polyfill bloat. Refactor any buffer-dependent code to run in the main process or behind a preload API that returns ArrayBuffer/Uint8Array. Update types in the image processing pipeline accordingly.

Refactor main process error handling to remove process.on('uncaughtException') side effects. Create a typed process error handler with lifecycle hooks and structured logging. Ensure we exit non-zero only for fatal states and display a user-friendly crash dialog with a log attachment.

The app theme logic is spread across multiple components. Create a ThemeService with a typed Theme enum and register a single listener for OS theme changes. Remove direct window.matchMedia calls in components and rely on the service’s observable.

Our domain events are plain strings. Introduce a typed EventBus with generic payloads and discriminated union event types. Replace ad-hoc event emitter usage in both main and renderer. Add strict type guards for payloads with runtime zod validation.

Refactor auto-launch on startup to a typed AutoLaunchService with platform adapters. Remove direct registry edits on Windows from random modules and use the service instead. Add tests to ensure enabling/disabling persists across restarts.

Refactor the asset loader to lazy load heavy modules via dynamic import with proper types. Annotate with /* webpackChunkName */ where needed. Ensure type-safe import() usage and update our preload bundler config to support code splitting.

We need to extract and type the CSV export logic. Currently the renderer builds CSV strings manually. Move to a CsvWriter utility with schema-driven columns, handle escaping and BOM, and stream large exports from main to avoid memory spikes.

The license validation logic mixes crypto with date parsing in a single function. Separate concerns: LicenseParser, LicenseVerifier, and Clock. Provide clear types for LicenseStatus. Add a fast path for already-verified licenses cached in memory.

Refactor the main window creation code to support restoring size/position per workspace. Extract a WindowStateService with a typed API and ensure it guards against off-screen coordinates. Add a migration for existing settings keys.

Our tracing spans are created inline with string names and inconsistent attributes. Introduce a typed tracer helper with enums for span names and attribute keys, and wrap it with a function that ensures end() is always called using a scope guard pattern.

Refactor the interop with the native module (node-gyp build). Wrap it in a typed adapter that catches errors and returns Result types. Replace all direct imports in the renderer with preload calls. Document supported architectures and add runtime checks.

The command line argument parsing in main.ts uses minimist with untyped results. Replace with zod-based parsing to produce a typed Args object. Remove the use of global variables and thread arguments through the AppContext.

Refactor the migration runner to be idempotent and strongly typed. Add a Migration type with up/down and preconditions. Ensure the runner can resume after partial failures and logs structured progress. Write tests that simulate failing in the middle.

The app uses require in a few remaining files. Migrate to import syntax and update ts-node/register usage in scripts. Ensure electron-forge/electron-builder configs still work and adjust tsconfig for moduleResolution node16.

Refactor the cache invalidation logic for project thumbnails. Replace manual setTimeout purges with a typed LRU cache that observes file mtime. Move thumbnail generation to main and communicate with renderer via a typed observable stream.

We need to remove implicit any from our RxJS pipelines. Introduce a typed operator factory that constrains input and output types, refactor custom operators, and augment the d.ts with module augmentation if needed to preserve inferred types.
Add a migration to rename the user_profile table to profiles and update all foreign keys accordingly.
Create a migration to add an index on notifications(user_id, created_at) for faster inbox loading.
Backfill null device_id values in sessions with a generated UUID, and enforce NOT NULL.
Drop the deprecated feature_flags table and remove the associated DAO code paths.
Add a unique constraint on downloads(asset_id, chunk_index) to prevent duplicate chunk rows.

Our beta build crashes on startup after applying the latest migration on Android 14. The schema upgrade from v23 to v24 adds a NOT NULL column to messages without a default. On fresh installs it’s fine, but upgrading users hit a constraint error. Please adjust the migration to either backfill data or provide a default that doesn’t break historical rows. Also verify that the Zig migrator handles PRAGMA foreign_keys properly during the transaction so we don’t get partial writes.

We need to migrate chat threads to support soft deletion. Add a deleted_at column to threads, backfill null, and ensure queries in the timeline DAO filter out deleted rows. Document the rollback path in case we need to revert. The read model uses a compound index on (inbox_id, updated_at desc) so make sure the new column doesn’t regress performance.

The analytics_events table is getting too big. Please add a migration to move rows older than 90 days into analytics_events_archive with identical schema. After migrating, create a view analytics_events_recent that unions the last 90 days plus any unflushed batch. Make sure sync code still works offline.

Our current schema stores image attachments in a single blob column. Add a migration to split into attachment_meta (width, height, mime) and attachment_data (blob), with a foreign key. Also create a cleanup job to vacuum after migration to reclaim space.

We shipped a partial migration for push_subscriptions that didn’t set a default for endpoint. Some rows have empty strings and break token refresh. Write a corrective migration that normalizes empty endpoint to NULL and sets NOT NULL with a default for new rows. Test on both iOS and Android.

Implement a migration to move settings JSON out of the users table into a dedicated user_settings table with a one-to-one relationship. The users table has grown large, and reading the JSON causes unnecessary page reads. Add indexes for user_id and last_updated, and provide a backfill script. Be sure to handle the case where the JSON is invalid: skip migration for that row and log it so we can investigate separately.

We’re standardizing timestamps to millisecond precision. Create a migration that converts all created_at/updated_at columns in messages, threads, and activities from seconds to milliseconds. For SQLite this means multiplying integer values by 1000. Update code paths that rely on integer division. Include a down migration that divides by 1000 without overflow. Validate on a copy with at least a million rows.

Add a migration to enable WAL mode for our SQLite database and set journal_size_limit to 50MB. On some devices we’ve observed high write contention during sync. Verify that migration runs once, persists across app restarts, and gracefully handles devices that don’t support WAL. Include metrics to confirm write latency improvements.

We want to consolidate the A/B test assignment tables. Merge ab_assignments and ab_overrides into experiments_assignments with a discriminator. Make sure the new table retains all constraints and that existing code paths read from the new structure. Provide a rollback that reconstructs the old tables from the merged data, including indexes and unique constraints.

Some migrations are failing on devices with low disk space, leaving us with a partially applied schema. Introduce a new migration pattern that uses a shadow copy: create new tables, copy in chunks with checkpoints, then atomic rename. Add progress logging and retry logic. Document how to detect and resume incomplete shadow migrations on next app launch. This should include cancellation handling if the OS kills the app mid-migration.

Add a migration to normalize phone numbers in contacts to E.164, and create a unique index on (normalized_phone). The normalization should happen in Zig during the migration, but ensure the database enforces uniqueness afterward. Provide a backfill report for conflicts, and add a fallback soft-unique approach if strict unique fails.

We need to change the primary key on messages from integer autoincrement to a ULID text key for cross-device merge. Plan a multi-step migration: add new column message_ulid, backfill with deterministic ULID v7-compatible order, add indexes, gradually switch FKs, then drop old PK. Include detailed steps, expected time on 100k rows, and rollback plan.

Please add a migration to encrypt sensitive columns in oauth_tokens using SQLCipher pragma rekey flow. We need to: verify SQLCipher availability, derive key using our existing keychain integration, update PRAGMAs (cipher_page_size, kdf_iter), and re-encrypt without losing data. A rollback should restore previous key. Include test vectors.

The offline queue table occasionally violates foreign key constraints when referenced entities are pruned. Add a migration to set ON DELETE CASCADE on all relevant foreign keys and backfill by deleting orphan queues. Ensure PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON is enforced before any write transaction. Provide a post-migration verification query and logs.

We’re switching our feature flag evaluation to use integer bitmasks. Add a migration that replaces feature_flags(flag_name, enabled) with feature_bits(mask integer) per user. Map known flags to bits, backfill masks, and remove stale rows. Include an adapter layer in Zig that reads mask and exposes the old API, to be removed in two releases.

Add a migration to create a materialized view for the home timeline that pre-joins messages, users, and reactions for fast rendering. Since SQLite lacks true materialized views, emulate with a table plus triggers to keep it in sync: on insert/update/delete of messages or reactions, update the materialized table. Provide benchmarking before/after.

The migration from v15 to v16 keeps failing during QA with a Zig error: OutOfMemory. The code buffers entire table copies for photos. We need to rewrite to stream rows in chunks using a reusable arena allocator. Also add a safety check to abort if free disk space < 200MB before starting. Provide a diagnostic log to help QA reproduce and verify.

Add a migration that replaces the legacy ts column type (text RFC3339) with an integer epoch_ms across all tables in a single transaction. Be careful with time zones; we’ve seen some rows with invalid timestamps. Those should be moved to a quarantine table with the original text. Provide a cleanup tool in Zig to review quarantined rows.

Please implement a migration to remove duplicates in the reactions table. Define uniqueness on (message_id, user_id, emoji) and add an index to support it. Before adding the unique constraint, dedupe by keeping the earliest created_at. Include a report in logs showing how many rows were removed, and make sure the app displays counts correctly.

Add a migration to move location history to a separate database file (location.db) to reduce contention with messages. This requires copying schema and data, setting up ATTACH/DETACH in migration code, and updating DAOs to open the second DB. Make sure we keep PRAGMA foreign_keys and WAL mode consistent across both DBs.

Introduce a new migration to compress large blobs in attachment_data using Zstd. For devices lacking NEON, fallback to uncompressed storage. Add a versioned blob_format column. During migration, re-encode existing blobs in batches. Include error handling to skip a blob if compression fails, log it, and continue. Validate data integrity with checksums.

We’re seeing migration race conditions during app startup when multiple threads access the database concurrently. Add a global migration lock using a dedicated migrations_lock table or file lock. Ensure the Zig initialization code acquires the lock before opening DAOs and releases after success or failure. Provide a unit test simulating concurrent opens.

We need to add a migration that sets default values safely. In v28 we added settings(theme text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'system'), but some rows ended up with NULL due to old SQLite versions ignoring defaults on ALTER. Write a fix-up migration to coalesce NULLs and re-assert NOT NULL constraints by rebuilding the table. Include a table-copy pattern.

Please write a migration to convert the bookmarks table to use partial indexes for is_archived = 0 queries. Create the index only if SQLite version >= 3.8.0. If not supported, create a normal index instead. The migration should probe sqlite_version via PRAGMA and branch accordingly, logging the chosen path.

Add a migration to track sync watermark per collection. Create table sync_state(collection TEXT PRIMARY KEY, watermark INTEGER NOT NULL, last_error TEXT). Backfill from legacy last_sync_ts column in users. Also add a safe retry increment if we detect monotonicity violations. Include unit tests for monotonic updates.

Large schema change ahead: split messages into messages_base and messages_content to reduce row size. Provide a multi-step migration with snapshot isolation using a temp view to maintain read availability during the migration. Include Zig code for batched copying and show how to resume after interruption using a progress table.

On some devices, the migration runner doesn’t pick up embedded SQL files due to bundle path differences. Update the code to read migrations from a compiled Zig array using @embedFile and index them by version. Also add a checksum column in schema_migrations to prevent replay or tampering. Document how to add new migration files.

Fix the migration that adds FTS5 index on messages_fts. It currently tokenizes only ASCII. We need unicode61 with remove_diacritics=2 and custom token separators. Also ensure we set content=messages and content_rowid=message_id to support efficient updates. Provide reindex steps and measure index size change.

Include a verification query comparing counts and sum(rowid).

Create analytics_events_keys(event_id, key, idx) and analytics_events_values(event_id, idx, value). Backfill from JSON blobs. Provide Zig code to stream parse JSON to avoid OOM. Add indexes and verify lookup performance.

The migration should rebuild tables where necessary to conform, and run a data scan to report rows that would be truncated or coerced.

Add a migration to replace the legacy session_tokens table with a view backed by auth_sessions to keep API compatibility. The view should map columns and apply WHERE is_revoked = 0. Also, update the write paths to go to auth_sessions and reject writes against the compatibility view with INSTEAD OF triggers.

The build.zig migrator step is not deterministic across platforms because of hash ordering. Update the code to sort migration filenames by semantic version before applying. Also add support for down migrations in dev builds via a -Ddown flag. Please include code showing how we parse and order versions safely.

Implement a migration to add column drafts.has_unsaved_changes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 and create an index on (user_id, has_unsaved_changes). Backfill by comparing local_updated_at vs server_updated_at. Ensure the app startup query uses the new index and doesn’t do a full table scan on large accounts.

We need an idempotent migration that adds missing indexes only if they don’t exist. Some SQLite versions lack IF NOT EXISTS for CREATE INDEX on older builds. Implement a helper that inspects sqlite_master to check presence before creating, and log which indexes were created. Apply to all DAO critical paths.

The migration to add thread_participants breaks due to incorrect foreign keys referencing users(id) where id is TEXT in production but INTEGER in dev. Make the migration robust by introspecting PRAGMA table_info(users) to detect type and adjust DDL accordingly. Include a unit test that runs against both variants.

Please create a migration to introduce a queue for background exports. Define export_jobs(id TEXT PK, type TEXT, state INTEGER, created_at_ms INTEGER, payload BLOB). Add a state index. Migrate pending exports from the old table export_requests. Include consistency checks and a trigger to auto-expire stale jobs.

FTS migration is too slow on large datasets. Implement an incremental migration that builds the FTS index in smaller chunks and yields to the event loop between chunks. Provide Zig code that schedules migration work via std.event.Loop or a platform abstraction so the UI doesn’t freeze during first launch after upgrade.

Add a migration to support per-user storage quotas. Create table storage_quota(user_id, bytes_used, limit_bytes, updated_at_ms) with a unique index. Backfill bytes_used by summing attachment_data sizes per user. Ensure we VACUUM after to reclaim space. Update data access layer to update quotas transactionally.

Add a migration that sets user_version to the highest applied version and verifies that applied checksums match compiled migrations. If mismatch, set a dirty flag and block app startup with a recoverable error.

Implement a migration that introduces a reactions_summary table maintained by triggers. It should hold message_id, like_count, laugh_count, etc. Backfill from reactions by grouping. Ensure triggers handle INSERT, DELETE, and UPDATE of emoji. Include performance tests showing that timeline queries are faster and battery usage decreases.

Let’s add a migration to move notification delivery to a state machine. Create notification_events and notification_state tables, and migrate existing notifications to the new model, preserving unread/read status. Provide detailed steps, ensure foreign keys cascade correctly, and verify that the in-app inbox still paginates efficiently.

Please update the migration runner to print progress like 30% copied (30k/100k) during heavy table rewrites. Implement this by querying COUNT(*) upfront and incrementing a counter per batch. Add logs to std.log.info. This will help QA assess whether the app is stuck during migration on older devices with slow storage.

We want to introduce per-thread mute settings. Add table thread_mutes(thread_id, user_id, muted_until_ms), unique(thread_id, user_id). Backfill from JSON in user_settings. Also add a migration guard that blocks if there are unprocessed push notifications to avoid changing behavior mid-delivery. Document the operational steps.

Add a reversible migration to convert all TEXT booleans ('true'/'false') in settings to INTEGER 0/1. Rebuild the table with strict types, then create a view settings_compat that casts back to TEXT for the old API. Mark settings_compat as deprecated and add a warning log on access.

Please add a migration to denormalize the last_message_preview onto threads for faster list rendering. Add threads.last_preview TEXT and last_preview_at_ms. Backfill by selecting the most recent message per thread. Create a trigger that updates these columns on new message insert or delete. Ensure we handle message edits correctly.

We should publish an example of using the Go SDK directly that mirrors CLI behavior. Users building automations want parity. Document how to authenticate and call list APIs with the same pagination and retries as the CLI, with full code and comments.

Please expand the "Configuration by environment" docs: show how to use profiles like --profile=staging, how profiles map to config sections, and precedence when combining with flags and env vars. Include examples and known caveats.
App freezes after returning from camera on Android 14. Likely a lifecycle issue with the ImagePicker module. Please investigate and prevent UI thread blocks.
Pull-to-refresh on the Feed screen sometimes stops working until app restart. Might be related to FlatList refreshControl state not resetting.
Notifications badge count not updating on iOS after reading messages. Ensure badge clearing logic runs when threads are opened.
Crash on splash when remote config fetch times out on slow networks. Add proper timeout and fallback defaults.
Audio playback stutters when app goes background/foreground on iOS. Handle AVAudioSession interruptions and resume playback cleanly.

Our React Native app’s deep link handler fails to navigate when the app is already in memory. Users click a link (myapp://order/123) and nothing happens unless they kill the app first. I suspect our Linking listener is only set in the initial mount and not when the app returns from background. Please make the deep link navigation idempotent and ensure it reattaches listeners on focus.

We’re seeing a regression with the in-app update prompt: it displays every launch even when the version hasn’t changed. The comparison logic between buildNumber and serverVersion seems off (string vs number). Fix the version check, debounce the prompt, and only show once per session.

On the Profile screen, the Save button stays disabled even after valid changes. The validation schema might be overly strict for optional fields (e.g., bio can be empty). Review the Yup schema and onChange handlers so the button enables properly.

Android back navigation on nested stacks is inconsistent: from Settings > Notifications > Details, pressing back jumps to Home instead of Notifications. This started after upgrading @react-navigation/native-stack. Please adjust screen options or headerBackTitle handling so back behaves predictably.

The feature flag gating for the new chat editor is applied client-side only. Users see a brief flash of the new UI before fallback. We should ensure the skeleton respects the flag state and avoid premature rendering until flags are fetched.

Crash on launch with Hermes enabled on Android after upgrading to RN 0.74. Stack points to a null reference in our JS bundle init. It only happens in release build. We need to investigate whether our global polyfills are conflicting with Hermes and ensure production builds polyfill only necessary APIs. Also please add an integration test for basic app startup with Hermes and non-Hermes to catch regressions.

The login screen intermittently shows "Network request failed" even when connectivity is fine. In airplane mode, we show the correct offline banner, but with weak Wi-Fi we get the fetch error. I think the problem is our fetch wrapper does not retry on ECONNRESET or timeouts and doesn't differentiate between DNS vs timeout vs server 500. Add exponential backoff retries with jitter for idempotent GETs, surface a user-friendly message, and log the error type for analytics.

Users report that tapping a push notification doesn’t navigate to the right screen if the app was cold-started. We rely on getInitialNotification() but sometimes the notification payload isn’t parsed before the navigator mounts. Please ensure the navigation container waits for the notification payload hydration and add a test with a simulated cold start notification.

The offline queue for POST /orders fails to replay when connectivity is restored if the app was backgrounded for > 5 minutes. I suspect the background task is being terminated on iOS and our persisted queue never rehydrates on foreground. Add robust persistence (e.g., AsyncStorage/SQLite), rehydrate on AppState change, and ensure duplicate submissions are avoided with idempotency keys.

On iOS, opening the WebView for third-party auth sometimes shows a blank white page. Probably WKWebView configuration or content blocking. Please reproduce with an iPhone 14 simulator and enable inline media playback and allowFileAccessFromFileURLs if needed, but ensure security best practices.

Repro: open Settings, toggle Dark Mode, navigate to Home, then back to Settings. The Switch resets to off but theme persists. Likely due to local component state not syncing with Redux selector on focus. Fix so UI reflects actual theme state on screen re-enter.

When a user logs out, the push token isn’t revoked on the backend. The next user on shared devices gets the previous user’s notifications. Ensure logout calls DELETE /push-tokens with the device token and clear local storage. Add a small spinner while revoking.

Android-only issue: images inside a FlatList flicker when scrolling quickly. Using FastImage and contentContainerStyle padding. Maybe missing keyExtractor or unstable keys. Please stabilize keys and consider removeClippedSubviews to reduce flickering.

We upgraded react-native-maps and now clustering stopped working. Markers appear, but tapping clusters does nothing. Could be the onClusterPress prop changed. Update props and verify the callout region animations still work smoothly.

Users on low storage devices see a crash when downloading offline maps. We don’t check available disk space before caching tiles. Add a preflight storage check, show an actionable error, and cancel the download gracefully.

The Redux middleware that refreshes auth tokens sometimes fires multiple refresh requests in parallel when multiple API calls 401 at once. This causes a race where the last token wins and earlier requests retry with stale tokens. We need a promise-based mutex to serialize refreshes and queue pending requests until refresh completes. Also, add logging to detect refresh storms and a circuit breaker if refresh fails repeatedly.

Search screen memory grows after repeated queries. On Android we eventually get OutOfMemoryError. Suspect we’re caching images and result arrays without eviction. Please audit the in-memory caches, replace with LRU, and ensure FlatList uses windowSize and removeClippedSubviews. Provide before/after memory profiles.

The biometric unlock prompt loops indefinitely if the user cancels on Android 13. Our code retries automatically, which is annoying. We should respect cancellation and only retry when the user explicitly taps Unlock again. Add a state machine for biometric flow and unit tests for cancel and fallback paths.

App check: On React Navigation, state persistence sometimes writes corrupt JSON to AsyncStorage, causing a blank screen on next launch. We need a safe-guard: wrap JSON.parse with try/catch, validate schema, and fall back to initial state if invalid. Also add a migration strategy when route names change.

After upgrading to Expo SDK 51, our Haptics feedback isn’t firing on iOS when pressing the primary CTA. It works on Android. Likely due to changes in haptics APIs requiring impactAsync vs notificationAsync. Please normalize calls and feature-detect device support to avoid unhandled promise rejections.

The animations on the Add to Cart button sometimes never resolve their promise, leaving the button disabled. We rely on Animated.timing with useNativeDriver. Ensure we always call onEnd even when animation is interrupted by navigation.

On the chat screen, messages occasionally render out of order after a reconnect. We rely on createdAt timestamps from the server, but when the device clock is off, local messages jumble. Sort by server-assigned sequence ID if present; otherwise reconcile with a merge strategy and mark uncertain ordering.

We’re seeing an exception when tapping the date picker on Android devices set to 24-hour format. The error mentions "Invalid time string". Please ensure our time parsing is locale-safe, using Date-fns or Intl instead of manual splits.

Realm database migration bug: schema v12 to v13 tries to rename a property but crashes with "Property already exists" for some users. Implement a two-step migration (add new prop, copy data, remove old prop) and guard against partial migrations.

Crash report from Sentry shows TypeError: Cannot read property 'navigate' of undefined in NotificationHandler when handling push taps. It happens when NavigationContainer isn’t mounted yet. Delay handling until isReadyRef is true or queue actions until navigator is ready.

We have a regression in image picker permissions on Android 14. The new READ_MEDIA_IMAGES permission is required, but our permission prompt still requests READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE. Update permission handling and add fallback for older SDKs. Make sure denied permissions result in a clear error and link to settings.

The web-socket reconnect logic is hammering the server when connectivity flaps. We need exponential backoff with jitter, max retries, and a healthy timeout before declaring a dead connection. Also, surface a UI banner with current connection state and last error.

iOS build crashes when enabling new architecture (Fabric/TurboModules). Stack trace points to our custom NativeModule for battery status returning a non-serializable type. Update to return serializable JS types, and test on both architectures.

When our app is backgrounded, geolocation updates continue, draining battery. We intended to stop high-accuracy tracking on background. Add AppState handlers to downgrade to low-accuracy or stop observers, and ensure permissions are respected on both platforms.

There’s a bug in the cart calculation where discounts are applied twice when items are restored from AsyncStorage. Likely duplicate application of applyDiscounts() during rehydrate and during first render useEffect. Debounce or ensure idempotent discount application.

Users with right-to-left languages see misaligned icons and mirrored Back arrow not appearing in headers. Make sure we enable I18nManager.allowRTL and use start/end paddings instead of left/right. Also flip SVG icons correctly.

Crash when sharing a PDF from the Orders screen on Android. The share intent fails with FileUriExposedException. We need to use FileProvider with content:// URI and set the correct flags. Ensure we don’t write files to external storage without permission.

The environment config is wrong in staging builds. We’re shipping production API keys in the staging channel. Fix the build-time env injection (babel plugin or eas config) and add a sanity check on app start to verify APP_ENV matches the bundle id.

Accessibility: VoiceOver focus doesn’t move into the modal when it opens, trapping keyboard users. Ensure accessibilityViewIsModal and focus an accessible element on modal open. Add test IDs and run a quick audit with Accessibility Inspector.

Our metric logging sometimes sends duplicate events because the analytics queue flush runs on focus and also on network reconnect. Add a dedupe key based on event name + timestamp window, and ensure flush is atomic.

On the Home feed, tapping a video thumbnail autoplays audio even when the "mute videos by default" setting is on. Likely a state mismatch between Redux and component local state. Make the player read from a single source of truth and respect the setting.

The background fetch task on Android occasionally throws an unhandled promise rejection and the OS disables our task. We need try/catch around the fetch, a timeout guard, and ensure we call BackgroundFetch.finish() always.

Our GraphQL client caches error responses, causing a stuck error state offline. Configure the cache to not store error results and implement proper fetchPolicy for mutations. Provide a repro and fix with tests.

SQLite database gets locked when we do a long-running migration on app upgrade. Reads fail with database is locked errors. Wrap migrations in a transaction and delay app readiness until migration completes, with a progress indicator to users.

Currency formatting bug: on locales using commas for decimals, the total displays incorrectly and arithmetic is wrong due to parseFloat. Switch to Intl.NumberFormat for display and use integer cents internally to avoid floating-point issues.

Using the new BottomSheet, sometimes the gesture conflicts with our map pan gestures. Adjust gesture priorities, enable waitFor on the PanGestureHandler, and ensure map panning takes precedence unless the sheet is fully expanded.

We’ve got a memory leak in the camera preview screen. After opening and closing multiple times, JS heap grows. Probably listeners not removed or Reanimated shared values persisting. Audit useEffect cleanups, remove event listeners, and profile with Flipper.

Our crash logs show the following stack when toggling Bluetooth devices from the Audio screen on Android 13:

Error: Cannot call method 'setPreferredDevice' of undefined
 at setBluetoothDevice (app/modules/audio/bluetooth.js:58)
 at onDeviceSelect (app/screens/AudioSettings.js:102)
 at pressHandler (app/components/DeviceItem.js:43)

The Bluetooth native module might not initialize before the screen mounts. Ensure module is available, handle null gracefully, and lazy-init the audio route.

Repro steps for a crash in the Order Details screen:
1. Login with test user
2. Go to Orders -> pick any order
3. Tap "View Invoice" (opens PDF in WebView)
4. Quickly rotate the device twice

Observed:
App crashes with "Attempt to invoke virtual method 'android.view.View android.view.View.findViewById(int)' on a null object reference".

Likely our orientation change unmounts the WebView while the progress bar is still referencing a stale ref. Add guards and cancel loading on unmount.

The following error spam appears in Sentry after we upgraded to React Navigation 6:

TypeError: Cannot read property 'addListener' of undefined
 at useFocusEffect (node_modules/@react-navigation/core/src/useFocusEffect.tsx:12)
 at ProductList (app/screens/ProductList.tsx:45)

We might be calling useFocusEffect outside of a screen component. Move it inside the navigator context or replace with useEffect + navigation.addListener('focus').

Detailed repro for avatar upload failing on slow networks:
- Device: iPhone 13, iOS 17
- Build: 2.8.4 (RN 0.72, Expo EAS)
- Steps:
  1) Open Profile
  2) Tap avatar -> select a 5MB image
  3) Observe progress hits ~70% then fails

Console logs:
[Upload] PUT /users/me/avatar 413 Payload Too Large
[Upload] Retrying with chunked=false
[Upload] Error: Network request failed

Code snippet:

async function uploadAvatar(uri) {
  const buf = await FileSystem.readAsStringAsync(uri, { encoding: FileSystem.EncodingType.Base64 });
  return fetch(`${API}/users/me/avatar`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'image/jpeg' },
    body: Buffer.from(buf, 'base64')
  });
}

Issues:
- We base64 the entire file, inflating size and memory.
- Missing Content-Length and no chunked upload.

Fix:
Use multipart/form-data with a file stream, or use UploadTask with resume support. Add server-side max size negotiation and compress images before upload.

Login crash trace from Android release build (Hermes):

Fatal Exception: com.facebook.react.common.JavascriptException: TypeError: undefined is not a function, js engine: hermes
 at onSubmit (app/screens/Login.js:88)
 at commitHookEffectListMount (index.android.bundle:19912)

Our code:
