const onSubmit = async () => {
  await analytics.track?.('login_attempt'); // optional chaining
  const res = await api.login(email.trim(), password);
  ...
}

In release, analytics.track is not a function (mocked object?). Ensure analytics is initialized before use, or guard with typeof track === 'function'. Add a no-op implementation in production if not loaded yet.

App occasionally shows ghost toasts on navigation. Likely due to a mounted singleton Toast component not unmounting timers on route change. Add useEffect cleanup and cancel timeouts. Also ensure only one toast queue exists using a context provider.

Deep link routing bug with path params containing spaces or unicode. Example link: myapp://search/%F0%9F%8D%8E apples. Our parser splits on space and only decodes partially. Use decodeURIComponent and avoid splitting the URL manually; rely on Linking.createURL with path config.

We’re hitting a warning and performance issue on large lists:

VirtualizedLists should never be nested inside plain ScrollViews with the same orientation because it can break windowing and other functionality - use another VirtualizedList-backed container instead.

Audit our screens, especially Catalog and Orders, and replace nested ScrollView + FlatList with a single FlatList and ListHeaderComponent.

Location permission prompt loops on Android when user selects "Only this time". Our code treats it as denied and re-prompts immediately, causing an infinite loop. Detect the new one-time permission and don’t re-prompt within the same session. Provide a settings fallback link.

Startup performance regression: time to interactive increased from 1.8s to 3.1s on Pixel 6 after enabling remote config fetch on launch. Defer non-critical fetches until after first paint. Use InteractionManager.runAfterInteractions and lazy load heavy modules. Add perf marks with Performance API and track in analytics.

Require mTLS for all internal service-to-service calls in the C API gateway. Add client cert validation and reject connections without SAN = service name. Include metrics counters for handshake failures.
Replace custom base64 decoder with a constant-time vetted implementation and audit all error paths to avoid leaking length or padding errors to clients.
Disable insecure TLS ciphersuites. Enforce TLS 1.2+ with ECDHE and AEAD only. Add config flag to override for testing, default hardened in production.
Harden JSON parser against oversized fields. Enforce a 64 KB per-field limit and reject nested arrays deeper than 32 levels with structured error responses.
Add rate limiting per API key and IP at the ingress layer. Use token bucket with sliding window and return 429 with Retry-After.

We need to implement request signing verification for our public endpoints used by the mobile SDKs. The C API service should verify HMAC-SHA256 signatures using a per-app secret, with a 5-minute timestamp tolerance and a replay cache keyed by nonce. Include clear error responses when the signature is invalid or the timestamp skews too far, and make sure logs do not include the raw signature or secret-derived values.

In our current logging we sometimes dump HTTP headers on 4xx/5xx. Please scrub Authorization, Cookie, and X-Api-Key headers in all log lines. Review both structured JSON logs and the human-readable access logs and ensure redaction is applied consistently across release and debug builds.

Some endpoints accept file uploads that we pass to an image library. We should enforce MIME type and magic byte validation, limit to 10 MB, and store uploads in a chrooted temp dir with noexec,nodev,nosuid. Also reject overly long filenames and normalize paths to prevent path traversal when saving to disk.

We have a potential SSRF vector via the /v1/fetch-url endpoint that proxy-fetches resources. We should block private IP ranges (RFC1918, link-local, loopback, IPv6 ULA), enforce a DNS pinning check, cap redirects to 2, and only allow http(s). Provide a deny-list and allow-list mechanism in config.

Please add secure defaults for cookie flags on session tokens issued by the C API. Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, and consistent domain scoping. Also ensure we rotate session IDs on privilege elevation.

Our TLS client currently sets hostname verification off when talking to the metadata service. We need hostname/SAN verification on, OCSP stapling if available, and certificate pinning for the metadata host fingerprint. Make it configurable via the service config and fail closed if pinning fails in production profiles.

Add support for Argon2id password hashing in the auth module, replacing PBKDF2 where possible. Keep PBKDF2 for legacy but add a migration path on successful login. Provide benchmarks for reasonable time/memory parameters, and ensure scrypt/argon2 code paths are covered in unit tests.

Several endpoints reflect user-provided values in error messages. Let's standardize error responses to avoid reflecting raw input. Provide an opaque error code, a safe message, and an internal correlation ID for logs. Make sure we consistently escape JSON and avoid including SQL or file paths in user-facing messages.

The admin UI shows stack traces on 500 errors when the API responds with debug=1. Let's make sure the C API only includes stack traces if an explicit server config flag is enabled and the environment is non-production. For production, return a generic message and log the stack trace internally with rate limiting.

We need a per-tenant encryption key strategy for data at rest. Introduce a KEK/DEK model: DEKs encrypt tenant data; KEKs wrap DEKs and are rotated quarterly. Use AES-256-GCM via OpenSSL EVP. Implement key rotation tooling and ensure authenticated encryption tags are verified before decryption, returning a distinct error for authentication failures without revealing which part failed.

Add strict input validation to the /v2/users endpoint. Reject usernames with control characters, normalize Unicode (NFKC), and limit length to 64 bytes after UTF-8 encoding. Also enforce email syntax validation and MX DNS resolution with a 2s timeout to avoid slow lookups.

Please audit our use of sprintf/strcat in the request router. Replace with snprintf/strlcpy/strlcat where supported, check return values, and ensure we always reserve space for null terminators. Add unit tests to prove truncation and error handling don't leak partial secrets into logs.

The database connection pool currently reuses connections across tenants without resetting session-level variables. Add a post-checkout reset hook to clear search_path, set role, and any GUCs. Also ensure we disable SQL string concatenation in dynamic queries by using prepared statements only.

Implement an allow-list for CORS origins in the HTTP layer. Reject wildcard origins. For credentialed requests, only reflect origins from config. Also restrict exposed headers and methods, and disable caching of preflight responses that include sensitive headers.

Our CLI uses the API and stores the token unencrypted in ~/.api/config. We need to migrate to OS keychains (macOS Keychain, Windows DPAPI, Linux libsecret), fallback to file with 0600 and a warning. Add a one-time migration routine and rotate tokens during the migration.

We’re seeing a potential heap-use-after-free when a TLS handshake fails and the connection is recycled in our epoll loop. Can we review the shutdown path? Under load, occasionally we get a segfault and this AddressSanitizer report: ================================================================= ==41237==ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-use-after-free on address 0x6110000b6b80 at pc 0x0000004c3b2e bp 0x7ffe26b694d0 sp 0x7ffe26b694c8 READ of size 8 at 0x6110000b6b80 thread T1 #0 0x4c3b2d in tls_conn_is_alive src/net/tls.c:219 #1 0x482f09 in io_reactor_tick src/net/reactor.c:401 #2 0x43e6da in worker_main src/worker.c:112 #3 0x7f8e98bb7608 in start_thread (/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libpthread.so.0+0x8608) #4 0x7f8e988b6132 in clone (/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6+0x121132) 0x6110000b6b80 is freed by thread T1 here: #0 0x7f8e990a2c10 in free (/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libasan.so.6+0xb2c10) #1 0x4d1194 in tls_conn_free src/net/tls.c:610 We likely need refcounting or to null out pointers after free, and ensure the reactor deregisters FDs before freeing.

New static analyzer warnings flagged timing side-channels in our token comparison. Replace memcmp with a constant-time compare. Something like: int ct_equals(const uint8_t *a, const uint8_t *b, size_t n) { uint8_t acc = 0; for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) acc |= a[i] ^ b[i]; return acc == 0; } Wire it into HMAC checks and CSRF token validation. Also verify compiler doesn’t optimize it out (use volatile or dedicated library).

When running fuzz tests against our HTTP parser, the service sometimes hangs. Repro steps: build with ASan/UBSan, run ./fuzz_http seeds/corpus -max_total_time=60. Logs show: [warn] parser: oversize chunk length=4294967295 [error] allocate(): integer overflow detected. Please add guards on chunk sizes, content-length, and header counts. Also enforce a global per-connection memory cap and abort parsing early with a 413 error.

The JWT verification code accepts alg=none if kid lookup fails. This is a critical issue. We must reject tokens with alg=none, and only allow alg in an allow-list in config (RS256/ES256). Also, make kid lookup failures return 401 and log at warn level without dumping the token payload.

Please add structured audit logging for privileged operations (user role changes, API key creation, tenant config edits). Include who, what, when, where (IP), correlation ID, and previous values. Logs should be tamper-evident: sign each record with HMAC and roll keys daily. Provide a verification tool.

In the multipart form handler we don't check for duplicate field names. Attackers can smuggle alternate values. Reject duplicates for single-valued fields, or only accept the first occurrence and log at info with a metric. Also enforce per-field size limits early while streaming.

We should enable FIPS mode when running on hosts configured for it. Detect OpenSSL FIPS provider availability at startup, and fail fast if config requires FIPS but the provider isn't loaded. Document the behavior and add a health endpoint that reports crypto module status without exposing sensitive internals.

Add payload encryption for our queue messages between the C API and the background worker. Use AES-256-GCM with nonces from a per-queue counter + random salt to avoid reuse. Include versioned headers and rotate keys every 90 days. Reject messages with invalid tags and write minimal logs.

We have potential SQL injection in the analytics endpoint. See code: char query[2048]; snprintf(query, sizeof(query), "SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE tenant='%s' AND type='%s'", tenant, type); Please replace with prepared statements: const char* params[2] = { tenant, type }; PGresult* res = PQexecParams(conn, "SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE tenant=$1 AND type=$2", 2, NULL, params, NULL, NULL, 0); Ensure all dynamic queries are parameterized and audit others.

Please implement request body size limits and streaming backpressure. Right now reverse proxies can be bypassed by direct connections. In C, enforce max 10 MB per request, with incremental checks during readv. Return 413 with a generic JSON error. Add config overrides and per-route overrides.

There's a TOCTOU bug in the file download endpoint. We stat() a file for size and permissions, then open it later. An attacker could swap symlinks. Use openat with O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC and fstat on the opened fd, verify inode matches expectations, and sendfile from that fd.

In our config loader, secrets can be printed with -v. Ensure that when printing config, any key with name matching /secret|password|token|key/ is redacted. Also review crash paths so secrets aren't dumped in stack traces or core dumps. Consider setting PR_SET_DUMPABLE=0 in prod.

TLS session tickets are enabled with a static key that hasn't rotated in months. Implement a ticket key rotation routine: maintain 3 keys (current, prev, next), rotate every 24 hours, and drop keys older than 48 hours. Ensure zeroization of old keys using explicit_bzero.

Please add a WAF-like rule to block JSON/XML entities expansion and limit top-level array sizes. Our XML parser should have entity expansion disabled entirely to prevent XXE. For JSON, cap top-level array at 1000 elements and reject unknown top-level types with 400.

Implement IP address normalization and canonicalization before applying allow/deny rules. Today we occasionally bypass with IPv6-mapped IPv4 (::ffff:127.0.0.1). Normalize to a common form and ensure private ranges are caught. Add unit tests for edge cases.

The S3 signer we use for outbound uploads leaks query params in logs. Update logging middleware to avoid logging full URLs when sensitive query params like X-Amz-Signature or token are present. Log host and path only, with a hash of the query for correlation.

Under heavy load, we see random failures verifying OCSP stapling, causing handshake aborts. Sample log: [tls] OCSP response expired: nextUpdate=2024-09-12T11:02:03Z now=2024-09-12T11:02:04Z. Make verification tolerant to minor clock skew via a small grace, and implement background OCSP prefetch/refresh. Fail closed if beyond grace in prod; allow open in dev.

Our HSTS header is missing includeSubDomains and preload. Please set Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload for public domains. Add config guard to disable in non-public environments to avoid bricking localhost testing.

Add a global kill-switch to revoke leaked API keys. Implement a deny list stored in Redis with a last-checked TTL, so the C API can quickly invalidate keys without restart. Include metrics and an admin endpoint to add/remove up to 1000 entries per minute with rate limits.

The CSRF middleware for cookie-based sessions doesn't check the request method properly. It only looks for header X-CSRF-Token but allows GET requests to modify state if the header is present. Enforce method checks: only validate tokens on state-changing methods and reject side effects on GET/HEAD.

Can we harden our libcurl usage? Set CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER=1, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST=2, CURLOPT_PROTOCOLS to CURLPROTO_HTTPS, disable redirects by default, and restrict HTTP headers we forward. Also set CURLOPT_TIMEOUT to 5s and a tight CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS, plus CURLOPT_PINNEDPUBLICKEY for critical hosts.

We need to migrate from custom RNG to a CSPRNG. Use getrandom() on Linux, arc4random_buf on BSD/macOS, and fallback to OpenSSL RAND_bytes with health checks. Remove the homegrown XORShift. Add a startup self-test that fails if entropy isn’t available.

Our WebSocket upgrade path doesn't validate the Sec-WebSocket-Protocol and echoes back arbitrary values. Limit to an allow-list of protocols and sanitize. Also rate-limit handshake attempts per IP and require authentication before upgrading when accessing private topics.

A bug in the header parser allows obs-folding style headers with CRLF+space to sneak through and bypass size limits. Reject any obs-folding per RFC 7230. Add tests where attackers try multi-line headers and leading whitespace to break our enforcement.

Valgrind reveals uninitialized memory sent over the network when we reuse response buffers. Please zero memory on allocation or before send. For example: void* buf = calloc(1, size); instead of malloc, or explicit_bzero before reuse. Ensure zeroization doesn’t get optimized out; use OPENSSL_cleanse or sodium_memzero where available.

Implement per-endpoint authorization scopes. Today we just check that an API key is valid. Define scopes like read:user, write:user, admin:keys. Attach scopes to keys and enforce checks in each handler. Add a deny-by-default posture and a helper macro to reduce boilerplate.

Our static file server sets Content-Type based on file extension. To prevent content sniffing attacks, add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and always set a safe default like application/octet-stream for unrecognized types. Also disallow inline content for uploads using Content-Disposition: attachment.

Investigate this crash when parsing a malformed JWT header. Backtrace (gdb): Program received signal SIGSEGV, Segmentation fault. 0x000000000045a921 in b64url_decode (in=0x7ffff7fdb000 "eyJhbGciOiJub25lIiwi", inlen=22, out=0x0, outlen=0x7fffffffd6f0) at src/crypto/jwt.c:88 88 if (*outlen < needed) return -1; Looks like we dereference out when it's NULL. Change API to two-pass: call with out=NULL to get required length, then allocate. Also validate JSON keys and reject alg=none.

Our input sanitization for the search endpoint lowercases everything but doesn't normalize Unicode. Attackers can bypass keyword filters using homoglyphs. Add ICU-based normalization to NFKC, then lowercase using locale-insensitive rules. Cap the normalized length to prevent buffer growth.

Build with -fstack-protector-strong -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 -O2 -fPIE -Wl,-z,relro,-z,now and enable ASLR via system config. Document the flags in BUILDING.md and gate them behind RELEASE=1 to avoid slowing down dev builds. Add CI checks that fail if flags are missing in release.

Our metrics endpoint exposes internal build info including library versions. Restrict the /metrics handler to the admin network or require an auth token. Also scrub sensitive labels that include endpoint paths with IDs, which could leak PII in Prometheus.

During SSO callback, we accept state parameter but do not bind it to the session. Bind state to a server-side nonce stored in the user's session and expire it after 5 minutes. Reject mismatches with a generic 400 and log at warn with correlation ID.

Implement defense-in-depth on XML parsing. Use libxml2 with these settings: xmlReadOptions opts = XML_PARSE_NONET | XML_PARSE_NOENT | XML_PARSE_DTDATTR | XML_PARSE_DTDVALID; but make sure to remove XML_PARSE_NOENT to avoid entity expansion; set XML_PARSE_NONET to block external resources. Add explicit xmlDisableEntityLoader for older libxml2. Write a fuzzer corpora.

Add a sandbox for image processing via seccomp-bpf profile that only allows read, write on pre-opened fds, and necessary syscalls. Drop privileges with setresuid to a dedicated user and chroot to a minimal directory. Ensure no capability leakages and add runtime checks.

Here’s a concrete crash from fuzzing the HTTP chunked parser with undersized chunks. Logs: [error] chunked: expected CRLF after chunk, got '\0' [panic] abort at src/http/chunked.c:142. Code snippet: if (buf[i] == '\r' && buf[i+1] == '\n') { i += 2; } else { abort(); } We should avoid abort and instead fail parsing gracefully with 400. Also bounds-check i+1 to avoid OOB reads, and enforce a maximum total chunks size.

The password reset flow emails include a token valid for 24h but not bound to IP/device. Reduce validity to 15 minutes, bind to user agent hash and requesting IP CIDR, and invalidate on password change. Store token hashes with Argon2id and compare in constant time.

Can we add a build-time check that forbids using strcpy/strcat/gets/scanf without field width? Use a compile-time grep in CI or -Werror=deprecated-declarations where possible. Also add a clang-tidy rule to flag risky C functions and pointer arithmetic on user input buffers.

Our admin RPC over Unix domain sockets doesn’t set file permissions correctly; anyone on the box can connect. Ensure we create the socket with umask 077 and chmod 0600. Also set SO_PEERCRED and verify the UID/GID matches an allow-list before accepting commands.

Implement envelope encryption for backups. Before uploading DB dumps, compress and encrypt using age or OpenSSL AES-256-GCM with authenticated metadata. Keys should be fetched from KMS with an AAD tying them to the backup date and tenant. Verify integrity on restore.
Please add cursor-based pagination to GET /api/v2/users and deprecate the page/size params. Keep backward compatibility for one release with a deprecation warning header.
Expose a HEAD /api/health endpoint that returns 200 without body and includes X-App-Version from build info.
Rename the customerId field to accountId across all v3 API responses and accept both in requests for now. Include a deprecation notice in response headers.
Allow PUT /api/v1/profile to accept an optional timezone field and validate against IANA tz database.
Change all 4xx error bodies to include a machine-readable code property, not just message.

We need to add support for PATCH in our order status API so mobile can update only the deliveryStatus field. Right now they have to send the entire order payload and it’s causing accidental data overwrites. Add JSON Patch (RFC 6902) support and validate allowed operations.

Can we version the public webhook endpoints to /api/webhooks/v2, add HMAC-SHA256 signatures in the X-Signature header, and provide a verification endpoint? Our partners need a deterministic verification method before acknowledging an event.

Please make the product search API return consistent sorting by default. Right now we sort by "relevance" but the algorithm can change between deploys. Define a stable sort key (createdAt desc, then id) when sort is not provided, and document it.

Marketing needs CORS expanded for GET /api/public/promotions from https://app.example.com and https://admin.example.com. Only allow GET and HEAD, disallow credentials, and set a 1-hour preflight cache.

We need to annotate all v2 endpoints with explicit Produces/Consumes for application/json; charset=UTF-8 because Android clients are treating strings as ISO-8859-1. Ensure the ResponseEntity sets correct Content-Type.

We’re migrating Payments API to v2 with idempotency keys. Add support for Idempotency-Key header on POST /api/v2/payments, store keys for 24h, return the same response for retries, and lock on (key, merchantId) to avoid double charges. Include a 409 with a clear error code if the idempotency key is reused with a different payload.

Our GraphQL gateway is calling the REST /api/v1/inventory endpoint in batch. Please add a bulk inventory check endpoint POST /api/v1/inventory/bulk that accepts up to 500 SKU ids and returns an array of {sku, availableQty}. It should respond within 150ms p95 and use a single DB query with WHERE sku IN (...).

We need to standardize error responses to the following schema across all endpoints: { "timestamp": ISO8601, "status": int, "error": string, "code": string, "message": string, "path": string, "details": object }. Replace the current exception handlers in ExceptionAdvice and retrofit the validation errors to include a code like VALIDATION_FAILED. Make sure to include a sample in Swagger.

Please deprecate /api/v1/session and move to /api/v2/auth/login issuing JWTs. Support both for two sprints, but add a warning header Deprecation: true and Link: <doc-url>; rel="deprecation" for v1. Update security filters to bypass session creation for v2.

Add OpenAPI annotations to the file upload API with explicit max file size and supported content types image/png and image/jpeg. The Swagger UI should display a 413 example and we need to test multipart boundary parsing with RestAssured.

QA reports null pointer exceptions when calling PUT /api/v1/users/{id} with an empty payload. We should return 400 with a problem+json body instead of 500. Implement Bean Validation with @Valid and custom ConstraintViolation translation.

We need to replace the legacy XML responses in Shipping API with JSON. The endpoint GET /api/v1/shipping/rates still produces text/xml. Update to application/json, convert domain models to DTOs, and provide a migration doc for clients. For one release, support ?format=xml but mark it deprecated.

iOS app needs an endpoint to refresh access tokens without sending the refresh token in the body. Add POST /api/v2/auth/refresh that reads Refresh-Token from an HttpOnly cookie and rotates both tokens. Update CSRF and CORS config accordingly.

Please ensure all list endpoints support a stable opaque cursor for pagination. Implement encode/decode of the cursor with HMAC signing to prevent tampering. Provide nextCursor and hasMore in responses. Document example usage in OpenAPI and add contract tests.

The Admin UI expects the orders export API to stream CSV rather than build in memory. Update GET /api/v1/orders/export to use ResponseBodyEmitter or Spring WebFlux to stream rows, set Content-Disposition, and ensure the DB cursor is closed on client disconnect.

We’re seeing 500s when the mobile app calls POST /api/v1/checkout with a missing shipping address. Expected 422. Logs show a LazyInitializationException in the address mapping. Please update the controller to validate required fields before invoking service layer and return: { code: "MISSING_SHIPPING_ADDRESS" }.

Add ETag support to GET /api/v1/products/{id}. Compute based on updatedAt and id, return 304 when If-None-Match matches. Update caching headers and include tests showing conditional GET behavior through MockMvc.

We want to introduce field selection to reduce payload size. Implement a fields query parameter for GET /api/v2/users (e.g., ?fields=id,name,avatarUrl). Safely ignore non-existent fields and ensure we don’t serialize sensitive properties by mistake.

Backend team wants to deprecate request param includeCanceled on /api/v1/reservations. Replace with status=ACTIVE|CANCELED|ALL and support multiple status values. Update the JPA Specifications and add database index to support the new filter.

Can you add a unified rate limiter at the API gateway filter layer with configurable buckets per API key? We need 100 req/min default, burst 50, and a separate tier for partners=partner_* at 1000 req/min. Return 429 with a Retry-After header and a JSON error code RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

Android team is hitting 415 Unsupported Media Type on POST /api/v2/feedback when sending application/json; charset=utf-8. It works in Postman. Check Spring's content negotiation and ensure @PostMapping consumes application/json with charset handling. Add a unit test reproducing the exact Content-Type header.

We’re consolidating the profile picture APIs. Deprecate POST /api/v1/users/{id}/photo and add PUT /api/v2/users/{id}/avatar that accepts multipart/form-data with part name "file". Return a JSON body with {url, width, height}. Also, validate max size 2MB and types image/jpeg and image/png.

Partner integration requires a new webhook for refund events. Add POST /api/v2/webhooks/refunds with shared secret verification. Log signature mismatches as WARN and respond 2xx only after processing. Provide a retry policy with exponential backoff and idempotency on eventId.

Introduce consistent snake_case in JSON for v3 APIs but keep camelCase in Java. Configure Jackson PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE for package com.example.api.v3 only. Validate that legacy v1/v2 remain camelCase. Update sample payloads in the docs.

We need to return 207 Multi-Status for partial success in bulk user updates. Add a new endpoint POST /api/v1/users/bulk-update returning per-item status records with error codes. Do not fail the entire batch on single item errors.

Please migrate our Spring MVC controllers for notifications to WebFlux for push endpoints and expose Server-Sent Events at GET /api/v2/notifications/stream. Add heartbeats every 15s and verify Nginx proxy timeouts.

Error observed when calling GET /api/v1/catalog/items?sort=price:asc. Stack trace shows IllegalArgumentException: Invalid sort order "asc:". Reproduce with MockMvc and fix Sort parsing to handle colon-separated syntax.

We are getting this exception on POST /api/v1/orders when client sends an unknown property in the JSON body:

com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.exc.UnrecognizedPropertyException: Unrecognized field "coupon" (class com.example.api.dto.OrderRequestDTO), not marked as ignorable
 at [Source: (PushbackInputStream); line: 1, column: 123]

Please configure Jackson to fail gracefully: reject unknown properties with a 400 and a structured error listing all unknown fields. Update @ControllerAdvice accordingly and add tests for multiple unknown fields.

The Swagger/OpenAPI doc is missing enum values for OrderStatus in PUT /api/v2/orders/{id}. Add @Schema annotations to the DTOs to expose ACTIVE, PENDING_PAYMENT, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELED. Include examples for each state transition and document 409 when attempting invalid transitions.

Front-end needs a way to fetch localized product descriptions. Extend GET /api/v1/products/{id} to accept Accept-Language header (e.g., en-US, fr-FR) and return descriptionLocalized. If translation is missing, fall back to English but include a Content-Language header indicating the actual language returned.

We are seeing inconsistent serialization of BigDecimal prices due to scale differences. Update Jackson configuration to write BigDecimal as string with two decimal places across all price fields in v2 APIs only. Avoid floating-point conversion. Update associated tests and sample responses.

Add soft-delete filter to GET /api/v1/customers. Records with deletedAt != null should be excluded by default. Provide includeDeleted=true param for admins. Update JPA repository to add @Where and ensure counts reflect the filter. Be mindful of performance on large tables.

Security change: all POST/PUT/PATCH endpoints must require application/json Content-Type and reject text/json. Implement a filter that returns 415 with code UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE and logs the request path and header for forensics. Update Nginx config to pass through the content type untouched.

The mobile client needs unified time fields in ISO 8601 with timezone offset. Standardize all date-time serialization to OffsetDateTime, update Jackson JavaTimeModule, and ensure deserialization accepts both Z and offsets (+00:00). Provide migration notes for clients still sending epoch millis.

Add support for expand parameters to reduce N+1 calls. For example: GET /api/v2/orders/{id}?expand=customer,items.product should include nested resources. Limit depth to 2 and enforce a whitelist of expandables. Implement caching for expanded resources to keep latency low.

We need to change the invoices download endpoint from synchronous to async. Implement POST /api/v2/invoices/export to start a job and return 202 with Location to a job resource, and add GET /api/v2/jobs/{id} returning status and downloadUrl when ready. Include a cancel endpoint and a TTL for artifacts.

User endpoints should support conditional updates using ETags. Implement If-Match for PUT /api/v2/users/{id}; return 412 on mismatch. Update repository to detect concurrent changes via updatedAt. Add optimistic locking with @Version if not already present.

Bug: CORS preflight fails for DELETE /api/v1/saved-cards because Access-Control-Allow-Headers doesn’t include Authorization and X-Request-Id. Update our CorsConfigurationSource to include these headers and add integration tests using WebTestClient to simulate OPTIONS requests.

Please add validation and descriptive error responses for query params. Example: GET /api/v1/search?limit=-1 should return 400 with code INVALID_PARAM and details { param: "limit", expected: ">= 1" }. Use @Validated on controller class with @Min annotations and customize MethodArgumentNotValidException handling.

Our admin import API POST /api/v1/admin/users/import needs to accept application/csv and stream parsing rather than buffering. Implement reactive streaming with Flux<DataBuffer> if possible, or use a buffered reader with backpressure awareness. Return progress updates over SSE at /api/v1/admin/users/import/{jobId}/events.

Implement API key rotation for partners. Add endpoints: POST /api/v1/partners/{id}/api-keys (create new, mark old as expiring), GET /api/v1/partners/{id}/api-keys, DELETE to revoke. Add x-api-key usage analytics and return 401 with code INVALID_API_KEY for bad keys. Keys should be hash-stored with bcrypt.

We need to make the audit log API filterable by actorId and action type, and support time range queries with inclusive bounds. Add indexes, validate ranges, and ensure the API returns results sorted by createdAt desc with a stable cursor. Provide example queries in the OpenAPI documentation.

Error report for /api/v2/files/presign:

2025-11-10 11:32:42.781 ERROR 14125 --- [nio-8080-exec-7] c.e.api.FileController : Failed to presign URL
com.example.storage.StorageException: Bucket not found: uploads
	at com.example.storage.S3ClientWrapper.presign(S3ClientWrapper.java:63)
	at com.example.api.FileService.createUploadUrl(FileService.java:88)
	at com.example.api.FileController.presignUpload(FileController.java:55)
Caused by: software.amazon.awssdk.services.s3.model.NoSuchBucketException: null (Service: S3, Status Code: 404)

Please change the API to accept an optional bucket param with default from config, validate allowed buckets against a whitelist, and return 400 with code INVALID_BUCKET instead of 500. Also redact bucket names from logs.

We need to migrate authentication from session-based to Bearer JWT for all /api/v2 endpoints. Add a /api/v2/auth/login issuing Access and Refresh tokens, store refresh as HttpOnly with SameSite=None; Secure, and add a /api/v2/auth/refresh route. Update security filter chain to prioritize JWT and fall back to session only for /api/v1. Provide sample cURL requests and error responses.

We need to refactor order serialization to exclude internal fields. Currently the response leaks internalId and internalNotes. Here is a sample response from GET /api/v1/orders/123:

```
{
  "id": "123",
  "internalId": "order-8f9f0",
  "internalNotes": "priority customer",
  "total": 129.99
}
```

Introduce DTOs and use @JsonIgnore on sensitive fields. Add an API contract test to assert absence of these fields and update mappers accordingly.

When clients pass an empty array to POST /api/v1/notifications/batch, we currently return 200 with no-ops. Please change to return 400 with an error code EMPTY_BATCH and a message "At least one notification required". Add Bean Validation @Size(min=1) on the request model and wire up MethodArgumentNotValidException mapping.

The search API needs partial failure reporting for per-source errors. Example: when the external Catalog service times out, we still want to return local results plus an errors[] array. Add a field errors: [{source: "catalog", code: "TIMEOUT", message: "..."}] and set a header X-Partial-Failure: true. Ensure status code remains 200.

Please add HATEOAS links to v2 user API responses using Spring HATEOAS, including self, orders, and avatar links. Ensure link generation respects the current host and X-Forwarded-* headers when running behind the ALB. Add tests with ForwardedHeaderFilter enabled.
Fix intermittent crash when toggling airplane mode; the app freezes on splash screen until a force close.
Buttons in the onboarding carousel stop responding after swiping quickly. Likely a touch handler issue.
Android back button exits app from nested screens instead of navigating back. Need correct back handler.
Push notification badge count isn’t updating after reading messages. Badge remains stale.
Splash screen flashes white on dark mode devices. Respect system theme during initialization.

On iOS, the in-app browser opens links without status bar contrast adjustment. The status bar remains white on a white background, making time/network unreadable. Please adjust status bar style based on page content or use darkContent/lightContent appropriately.

The offline sync queue sometimes replays the same mutations twice after a network reconnect. We’re seeing duplicated updates in the activity feed. Could be the retry policy not clearing completed tasks or a race in our connectivity listener.

Image picker returns excessively large images on Android causing out-of-memory crashes on low-end devices. We need to downscale or compress before upload and add a size cap with a helpful user message if limits are exceeded.
Maps screen drains battery in the background. Location updates appear to continue after navigating away. Ensure listeners are removed and background location isn’t running without consent.
When users change language in settings, some strings update while others require a full app restart. Likely components caching translations or missing i18n rerender triggers.

In production builds, our crash reporter shows TypeError: undefined is not an object (evaluating 'state.user.id') coming from the ProfileHeader. It only happens on cold start. I suspect an initialization order issue where the auth state hasn’t hydrated before the header tries to read it. Please guard against null, and wait for hydration before rendering the header.

Payments: After upgrading to Stripe v12, the payment sheet sometimes throws "There is already a presented payment sheet" even though we’re awaiting presentPaymentSheet(). This seems tied to rapid navigation or opening modals. We need to debounce or ensure only one presentation is in-flight, and clean up listeners when unmounting.

Notifications on Android 13+ aren’t showing when the app is in the foreground, even though our handler is configured for heads-up. Check notification channels, importance, and the foreground service behavior. Also verify that we aren’t suppressing notifications in-app by accident.

On slow networks, our login form can be submitted multiple times, creating duplicate accounts. Implement server- and client-side idempotency, disable the button while awaiting the response, and ensure we handle timeouts gracefully with a retry prompt.
Dark mode: Our charts invert colors incorrectly on iOS. Lines become invisible on dark backgrounds. Please normalize theme tokens for chart colors and verify contrast against both themes.

We’re seeing a crash on Android related to deep links. If the app is killed and a user taps a universal link, it opens to a blank screen. Logcat shows the navigation container not ready yet. Can we defer initial linking until the navigation container’s ready event fires and add a fallback route if params are missing?

The camera preview occasionally freezes after taking a photo, particularly on Samsung devices. The capture promise resolves but the preview doesn’t resume. Likely missing resumePreview() or camera ref becomes null on re-render; ensure stable refs and proper lifecycle.
Redux persist rehydration sometimes wipes the cart on upgrade. We recently changed slice names; add a migration to map old keys to new and protect against undefined shapes while hydrating.

Our WebSocket reconnect logic spams reconnect attempts and hits the rate limit when a device is in captive portal. Add exponential backoff, stop after N attempts, and show a banner prompting the user.

The profile image upload fails with a 413 when photos exceed 5MB. Client should resize/compress before upload, and we need a better error message. Also verify the Content-Type and multipart boundaries.

The infinite list on the Activity screen occasionally skips items after users scroll fast, then duplicates them when scrolling back up. Using FlatList with getItemLayout but dynamic heights. Either remove getItemLayout or precompute heights; also ensure keyExtractor is stable.

On app resume, the access token is sometimes expired and we end up making an unauthorized API call before refreshing it. Add a token freshness check in the API client and queue requests until refresh completes. Avoid parallel refresh storms by gating with a single-flight promise.

On the Settings > Account screen, toggling email notifications flickers back to the old state before finally settling, confusing users. This looks like optimistic update without rollback handling or using a stale cache. Fix the race between local state and server response.

Android: requesting location permission twice pops two dialogs back-to-back if user navigates quickly between screens. Debounce permission requests and centralize the permission flow so only one prompt is possible at a time.

We’re hitting an error saving to AsyncStorage on large payloads: "NoSuchKeyException" in release builds only. Might be exceeding size limit or writing non-serializable data. Split data across keys and add compression; verify values are strings.

App crashes on launch for some iOS users with Hermes enabled. Crashlytics shows: TypeError: Cannot set property 'map' of undefined at bootstrap. This suggests a polyfill missing in Hermes. Verify required JS features are polyfilled and avoid relying on nonstandard prototypes.
The refresh control on the Home feed doesn’t stop spinning if the network request fails. Ensure finally() stops the spinner and display an error toast.
SQLite migrations fail when upgrading from v3 to v5. We dropped a column, and older devices throw "no such column" during reads. Add a safe migration path and guard queries until migration completes.

Users report being logged out randomly overnight. Suspect background task clearing storage on iOS due to memory pressure or keychain sharing settings. Investigate keychain access groups and background fetch behavior.

Crash on the Search screen when pasting multi-line text. Stack trace mentions "Invalid regular expression: Range out of order in character class". Likely we’re constructing a regex with user input. Escape input and cap length.
Our background upload service retries forever on 500s, burning battery. Implement capped exponential backoff, stop after N attempts, and surface a retry button in the UI.

The audio player stutters when switching networks (Wi‑Fi to LTE). Buffering strategy might reset. Use a more resilient streaming lib or pre-buffer during network change events; also consider pausing and resuming gracefully.
Login with Apple fails in test flight with error "invalid_client"; sandbox keys vs production? Verify bundle IDs, service IDs, and redirect URIs. Add richer logging for OAuth errors.

We’re seeing a memory leak on the Chat screen. After sending many images, memory usage never recovers. Ensure image components unmount cleanly, revoke object URLs, and clear blobs after upload completes.

The biometric prompt appears behind a modal on Android. We’re calling LocalAuthentication.authenticate while a React Navigation modal is open. Dismiss the modal first or use a full-screen prompt strategy.
App crashes when opening PDF previews on iOS 16. The WebView attempts to render data: URLs larger than 10MB. Switch to file:// with a temp file and use native viewers where possible.
The pull-to-refresh on Notifications occasionally triggers two API calls in parallel, causing race conditions in the unread count. Add a request-in-flight guard and coalesce responses.
Fast-tapping the "like" button triggers multiple API calls and inconsistent counts. Implement client debounce and server-side idempotency. Also update UI optimistically with rollback on failure.
Our analytics queue grows indefinitely when the app is offline, leading to large storage. Cap the queue size, drop oldest events, and compress payloads. Ensure flush on reconnect.
Deep linking into a nested tab route sometimes instantiates two instances of the same stack. Verify linking config and avoid duplicate navigation actions during initial state hydration.
App hangs on a white screen after OTA update via Expo. Looks like incompatible JS bundle with native code. Add runtime versioning and prevent applying incompatible updates; roll back on error.
During sign-up, the password meter flickers between weak/strong while typing quickly. Debounce validation and ensure consistent rules between client and server.

Intermittent error in the upload module when retrying a failed upload: "Cannot read property 'abort' of undefined". Possibly the xhr ref is lost after retry. Ensure we create a new instance and clean up listeners before retrying.
On iOS, the keyboard avoiding view pushes content too high in landscape, hiding buttons. Adjust behavior with keyboardVerticalOffset and handle safe area insets correctly.
The cache layer returns stale data after mutations. We’re using react-query; need to invalidate queries properly and update cache with mutation results to avoid flicker.
The app icon badge on iOS doesn’t clear after opening the app if notifications are disabled. We should call setApplicationIconBadgeNumber(0) regardless of push permission state.

We need to fix a regression where the status bar text becomes invisible on Android when showing a full-screen image modal. Ensure we set System UI visibility flags based on theme and restore on close.

JS bundle size spiked by ~700KB after adding a date library. We intended to tree-shake, but Metro may be pulling in locales. Use explicit imports, babel-plugin-date-fns, or moment/min with locale filtering.
Crash when toggling theme repeatedly on Settings: TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'removeEventListener'). Track down where we remove listeners on unmounted components.
On the Orders screen, pagination stops at page 3 with error 400. Our query param is pageIndex starting at 0, but server expects 1-based. Normalize and add tests.
Login errors not shown if the API returns a 422 with JSON {errors: {email: [...]}}. Our error parser expects {message}. Handle both shapes and display field-level errors.
Add dark mode toggle to the user settings page and persist preference in the user profile so it applies across devices.
Introduce a bulk CSV import tool for products with server-side validation and async processing (use a background job queue).
Enable WebAuthn (FIDO2) as a second factor for login; add device registration UI and backup codes.
Provide a public read-only GraphQL endpoint for product catalog with rate limiting and API keys.
Add a per-organization feature flag system with UI, backed by Postgres, to control beta features rollout.

We’d like a new feature to schedule recurring reports that are generated as PDFs and emailed at configurable intervals (daily/weekly/monthly). These should run off a server-side job queue and use existing report filters. Please include an admin UI to manage schedules, a delivery log (success/failure), and alerts when delivery fails more than N times.

Please add an audit log export feature for admins. We need a UI to filter by date, user, and action, and a backend endpoint that streams newline-delimited JSON for long ranges. The export should be permissioned, paginated/streamed to avoid memory spikes, and record who performed each export for compliance (store to audit_exports table).

Add a user-facing notifications center that consolidates alerts from various subsystems (billing, comments, deployments). We’ll need backend endpoints to list/mark-read, a paginator, WebSocket push for new notifications, and a React component with virtualized list rendering. Please ensure accessible keyboard navigation and ARIA live regions.

We need a new organization switcher in the header that supports searching orgs by name, displays avatar, and remembers last selection. The backend should expose a lightweight /api/orgs?query=... endpoint (100ms p95). Cache in Redis for 5 minutes; invalidate on membership changes.

Implement a custom data retention policy feature for enterprise tenants. Admins should set retention per collection (audit logs, events, sessions). The backend should enforce scheduled deletions with dry-run previews and a job log. Provide docs and safeguards to prevent accidental data loss.

Add a machine-to-machine OAuth2 client credentials flow so backend services can call our API securely. We’ll need a client management UI (rotate secrets, scope assignment), new token issuance endpoint, and scope-based authorization middleware. Please include rate limits and audit logging of token issuance and revocation.

We want a team templates feature where users can create, share, and version templates for projects. Think CRUD + versioning: draft, published, archived. Provide a diff view between template versions and an API to instantiate a template into a new project. Store drafts separately and enforce immutability on published versions.

Introduce request throttling per-user and per-IP layers, and make it configurable from the admin dashboard. Provide metrics per route (requests, throttled count) and a dry-run mode to observe before enforcing. We also want an allowlist for service IPs. Please document headers used (Retry-After) and error response format.

Please add a feature to let users define custom webhooks for events (user.invited, invoice.paid, project.deleted). UI to manage webhooks, secret signing (HMAC SHA-256), delivery retry with exponential backoff, and a replay capability. Provide an event validator and docs including sample payloads and signature verification code.

We need a stored query library for the reports page. Users should be able to save a query with parameters, share it, and schedule it. Validate SQL against an allowlist of tables and functions, and parameterize inputs safely. Provide a preview result set and explain-plan badge if cost seems high.

Add a endpoint and UI to manage IP access lists for organizations. Admins can add CIDR blocks, with optional temporary allow entries that auto-expire. Enforce at request middleware. Log denied attempts and expose a summarized report (top blocked IPs, time range).

Add file versioning to document uploads. When a file is re-uploaded, keep previous versions with metadata (uploader, timestamp, hash) and allow rollback. Present a version history in the sidebar and enforce quotas. Generate a diff preview for text-based files using a side-by-side viewer.

Please implement a time-limited sharing link feature for dashboards. Users can generate a public link that expires after N hours, optionally protected with a passcode. Record access logs. The public view should strip private widgets and obfuscate user emails.

We need a feature to embed dashboards in third-party sites via signed JWTs. Implement an embed token service with short TTLs, allowed origins, and row-level data scoping encoded in the token claims. Provide a React component that handles resize and postMessage for filter changes.

Add sandboxed API keys with fine-grained scopes and environment labels (dev, staging, prod). Keys should be revocable and rotated, with usage analytics (last used, counts). Provide prefixing for easy identification and secret hashing at rest. Introduce a key test endpoint.

Implement a backfill runner for historical analytics with a UI to queue backfills by date range and dataset. This should run chunked jobs, respect rate limits, and maintain idempotency via a job key. Include a progress bar and partial failure recovery with retry of failed chunks.

Add a feature to attach comments to individual rows in the data table view. Comments should support @mentions, basic markdown, and email/web push notifications. Provide an audit trail and soft-delete for moderation. Include a compact UI with lazy loading and optimistic updates.

Add a feature to pin dashboards and queries to the sidebar. Users can reorder pins and the order persists per user. Provide drag-and-drop and keyboard reordering for accessibility. Backend should expose GET/PUT /api/pins with optimistic concurrency control (If-Match header).

We need an export-to-Parquet feature for large datasets. Provide a streaming endpoint that writes Parquet in chunks, supports column selection and filters, and uploads to S3 with server-side encryption. Generate a signed download URL with a 24-hour expiry and email the user when ready.

Please add support for SSO login via Azure AD in addition to Google. Use OIDC, support Just-In-Time provisioning and SCIM for user lifecycle. Provide a mapping UI for roles and groups. Log SSO events in the audit table and include domain verification.

Implement per-field encryption for sensitive columns (ssn, bank_account) using Fernet with key rotation support. Add a key registry, re-encryption job, and transparent encryption/decryption layer in the ORM. Ensure search is disabled on encrypted fields and provide validation errors.

Add a feature to pause all outgoing webhooks for maintenance windows. Admins can set a schedule; system should buffer events and replay after resume with original ordering. Include a status banner and a dry-run to show estimated buffered volume.

We’d like a draft/publish workflow for the API documentation pages. Authors can save drafts, preview changes, request review, and publish with version tags. Keep a changelog and allow rollback to a prior published version. Provide a review assignment with notifications.

We want a new feature to allow users to define custom roles with granular permissions. Provide a UI to compose permissions, validate conflicts, and simulate a user’s access. Include an export/import of role definitions in JSON and a migration path from legacy roles.

New feature request: a streaming server-sent events (SSE) endpoint to push job status updates to the frontend job monitor. Each job emits progress, ETA, and step logs. The client should auto-reconnect with Last-Event-ID support, and the backend buffers per-job with a 5-minute TTL.

Please implement a built-in rate-limited public health endpoint that exposes app readiness, liveness, and build info. It should include optional upstream checks (DB, cache, queue) with timeouts and show degraded states. Add a UI badge in the admin header indicating current state.

We need a multi-tenant custom domain feature. Orgs can map a DNS hostname to their tenant. Provide ACME HTTP-01 challenge handling, certificate issuance/renewal, and per-tenant CSRF/session domain isolation. Include domain verification steps and a status page for domain onboarding.

We need a new ingestion endpoint to accept JSON Lines uploads up to 2GB, store to S3, and enqueue a processing job. Provide a resumable upload protocol with chunk checksums and a finalization step. The UI should show upload progress and handle network blips gracefully.

Add a new feature to generate and store data access consent receipts. When a user approves data sharing, create a signed receipt (JWS) that can be downloaded later. Provide an endpoint to validate a receipt’s signature and an admin interface to search receipts by user and date.

Please implement a soft-deletion preview mode. Before permanently deleting an object, show affected related records and linked resources. Provide a backend dry-run endpoint that returns a graph of impacted rows so the UI can render a confirmation dialog with details.

Add support for email aliases and catch-all routing for our inbound email processor. Admins should define routing rules in the UI; messages should be parsed and stored with DKIM/DMARC checks. Provide a webhook to forward to external systems with retry and failure quarantine.

We want a schema versioning feature for JSON payloads in our API. Each response should include a version header and a machine-readable schema URL. Add a negotiation mechanism where clients can request a version, and a deprecation schedule banner in the docs.

Implement a lightweight feature to bookmark any page state (filters, tabs, route). The backend should accept a POST that stores a compact, signed payload and returns a short code. Visiting /b/<code> restores the state. Expire after 30 days and prevent sensitive data from being embedded.

Add partial document search with highlighting. Use PostgreSQL full-text search for now, expose a /search endpoint that returns snippets with highlights and scores. The UI should show facets by type and date. Include query operators (phrase, exclude) and a query analyzer endpoint.

We need an export of billing invoices to QuickBooks Online. Add OAuth integration to QBO, a mapping UI for GL accounts, and a background job to sync invoices and payments. Provide reconciliation logs and a re-sync button on failures. Include a sandbox mode.

Please build a data lineage view for datasets. When a pipeline runs, capture inputs/outputs and store lineage edges. Add a UI to visualize dependencies and a REST endpoint to query lineage for a node. Include retention and pruning for old lineage points after 90 days.

Add a feature flag-driven beta for the new query planner. Users in the beta should see a toggle in profile. Capture metrics (latency, error rate) per planner and a per-query comparison mode with diff output. Allow quick rollback via the admin toggles page.

We want to add a new admin feature to impersonate a user for troubleshooting, with audit logging and explicit consent prompts. Expose an impersonation banner in the UI with a one-click return. Timebox sessions to 15 minutes and notify the user by email when impersonation begins/ends.

Requesting a CSV-to-ORM mapping wizard. Users upload a CSV, map columns to fields with validation previews, and the backend generates a dry-run report before committing. Provide custom transforms (trim, to_lower, date_parse) and saveable mapping templates.

Please add a bulk email composer with template variables and preview. Use our existing email service, but support segmentation filters and a send-at schedule. Add rate limiting, unsubscribe management, and a test-send to specified addresses. Log deliverability events back to the campaign.

Add a change history panel for environment variables. Any change should be versioned with who, when, and the diff. Provide rollback to prior versions, masking of secrets in the UI, and a signed attestation for each change stored in an append-only table.

We need a feature to upload and parse bank statements (CSV, OFX, PDF). Extract transactions, categorize them, and allow rule-based auto-categorization. Provide a reconciliation UI and export to CSV. Use a secure file processor and redact PII in logs.

Implement an in-app guided tour system. Authors can create tours with steps anchored to selectors, with conditions and completion tracking. Expose an API to trigger a tour by key and a UI to manage tours. Store progress per user and allow reset.

Add webhook-driven external approvals for deployments. When a deployment requires approval, send a webhook to an external system. Accept signed callbacks to approve/deny with metadata. Include a timeout and fallback path. Show approval status in the deployment timeline.

We want to add a custom SLA report generator. Users select endpoints, time windows, and SLO thresholds; the system computes uptime, latency percentiles, error budgets, and burn rates. Provide charts and CSV export. Run heavy calculations async and cache results by parameter hash.

Please implement per-tenant data export bundles with a one-click GDPR portability feature. It should package user profile, activity, and related data into a single ZIP, with JSON and CSV files. Provide an email link to download with expiry, and log the export for compliance.

Feature request: add a live metrics overlay to the admin dashboard using WebSocket streams. Show CPU, memory, queue depth, DB connections, and request rates. Include thresholds with color-coded alerts, and a pause/resume. Ensure data sampling does not add more than 2% overhead.

Add a sandbox environment creation wizard for new engineers. It should clone baseline configs, provision API keys with restricted scopes, seed sample data, and set feature flags. Provide an audit log, cleanup after 30 days, and a button to refresh the sandbox state.

I’d like a new feature for async task monitoring with trace IDs and per-task logs. The UI should show running tasks, retry counts, and a live log pane. Add endpoints to cancel, retry, and fetch logs. Implement structured logging and ensure logs are redacted for secrets.

New feature: user-configurable rate limits per API key. Provide a UI to set RPS and burst, enforce via Redis token bucket, and return headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining). Include a staging mode to simulate limits and produce violation reports per key.
Add a test helper to construct a default Client with in-memory auth and a no-op HTTP adapter, so we can unit test without hitting the network.
Please expose a public TestConfig builder for the SDK to simplify integration test setup and teardown in downstream crates.
Add a cargo feature `test-mock-time` to inject a deterministic clock into all time-dependent code paths.
Introduce a `#[cfg(test)]` backoff policy override to speed up retry loops in tests without changing production behavior.
Provide snapshot testing utilities for the SDK's serialization layer using insta, with redaction for secrets.

We need more documentation and examples for writing integration tests with our SDK against a local Postgres instance. Specifically, how to seed schemas, run migrations, and ensure test isolation with parallel runs. A short guide or README section, plus a working example test, would help new contributors ramp up faster.

Some tests for our async client are flaky in CI but pass locally. I suspect Tokio's default scheduler and time are different in GitHub Actions. Can we standardize on current_thread runtime in tests and use tokio::time::pause plus advance to remove sleeps?
Could we add a minimal example demonstrating how to test our SDK behind a corporate proxy? We should simulate proxy behavior in tests and verify CONNECT handling and proxy auth headers.
Please provide a mock implementation of our Storage trait for tests that simulates intermittent failures, to exercise retry and idempotency logic without external services.
Add support in test helpers for capturing and asserting structured logs via tracing, including setting ENV filters and validating spans for a single request lifecycle.

Our SDK’s pagination edge cases aren’t well-covered. We had a bug where page size 0 or exactly boundary sizes returns inconsistent next_page tokens. Add property tests to ensure consistent behavior across boundary values and randomized token strings. Keep the tests deterministic by fixing the RNG seed and document expectations.

We need an example test that shows using the SDK in a WASM context with wasm-bindgen-test. It should mock fetch and verify JSON serde compatibility without relying on Node APIs, ideally also showing panic hooks for better error messages.

Please add tests around graceful shutdown. Specifically, verify that in-flight requests are canceled properly when the client Drop is called, and that retry tasks are aborted. Include a tokio::time::pause example to make the test deterministic.

Our gRPC client (tonic) has minimal test coverage under network partitions. Add tests using a local tonic server that delays or drops responses, and verify the SDK’s retry/backoff logic respects deadlines and cancels correctly.
Can we add an example showing how to debug tests with RUST_BACKTRACE=1 and tracing in CI? The current CONTRIBUTING doesn’t mention how to capture logs from failed tests in GitHub Actions.

I’m getting a nondeterministic panic in a concurrency test around our cached token refresh logic. Please add a loom model test to validate there’s no race between refresh and request execution, and shrink the internals if a failure occurs.

With feature flags, our SDK behaves differently in no_std mode. Add tests that compile under no_std + alloc and ensure the API surface still works for serialization, errors, and client configuration. It should compile on thumbv7em and skip network tests.

We use proptest for the request builder. Please add comprehensive proptests for URI encoding and header normalization to catch invalid characters or invalid ASCII. Include shrinking to smallest failing inputs.

Add integration tests for the rate limiter using a deterministic time source. Verify burst capacity, sustained throughput, and token refill under high concurrency. Make sure tests never depend on wall clock time.
Can we add test coverage for Windows named pipe transports used in our local dev mode? Include a test that’s ignored by default and only runs on Windows in CI.

We need an end-to-end test using testcontainers-rs to run a local mock server + Postgres and verify our SDK’s migration helper. Include container logs in case of failure and ensure cleanup runs even if the test fails. Add a 2-minute timeout to avoid CI stalls.

Error we saw in CI:

```
thread 'migration::runs' panicked at 'migration failed: ForeignKeyViolation', src/migration.rs:88
note: run with `RUST_BACKTRACE=1` environment variable to display a backtrace
```

Let’s capture and assert the specific error kind.

Add a doctest demonstrating how to deserialize an error payload returned by our API with a custom serde formatter. Include an example that fails with a friendly message if the JSON shape changes. The doctest should compile and run with default features.

Can we add a fuzz target with cargo-fuzz for our query string parser? Include a CI job that runs a small corpus for 30 seconds. Also add a regression test for the minimal crashing input found in #812.

Introduce a Criterion benchmark group for our RetryPolicy evaluate() function and write a test to ensure the policy picks bounded delays under heavy jitter. Use black_box to avoid optimizer skew and document how to run in CI with minimal variance.

The SDK’s telemetry propagation needs tests. Add an integration test that sets a parent span, makes a request, and asserts the traceparent header is set. Use tracing and opentelemetry APIs, but avoid network calls by using a stub adapter.

Our WASI build broke some file IO tests because tempfile doesn’t work there. Please add conditional compilation and alternative test setup for WASI using in-memory files. Provide a minimal example confirming config load/save round trips under WASI.

We need to stabilize test ordering for our serde round-trip tests. They rely on HashMap iteration order. Convert to BTreeMap or use indexmap with a fixed hasher. Add a test asserting deterministic stable ordering for JSON outputs.

Add regression tests for HTTP status mapping: 429, 499, 502, 503, and 504 should trigger retry with exponential backoff; 400 and 401 should not. Mock the adapter and assert MaxAttemptsExceeded error structure matches the spec, including retry-after header parsing.

Some tests assume UTF-8 header values, but our API may return Latin-1 in rare cases. Add tests for lossy conversion behavior and make sure we don’t panic. Document the expected fallback strategy in the test names.

We should add a minimal Yew example that imports the SDK over wasm and demonstrate testing components with gloo + wasm-bindgen-test. Include a test verifying an async call via a mocked fetch and rendering the loading + success states.

Add a concurrency test using Tokio’s barrier and semaphore to validate that only one token refresh is performed under high contention. Provide metrics assertions for the number of refresh calls and verify no thundering herd occurs.

Our Diesel-based feature gate has minimal tests. Add integration tests that insert and query records using Diesel with our model types. Ensure the serde conversions align with our REST schema. Use a test transaction so it rolls back automatically.

Please add tests around our retryable file uploads via multipart. Mock the server to drop connections mid-stream and ensure we resume uploads correctly with proper content-range headers. Include a test for zero-length final chunk.

We need a comprehensive example for writing tests that use a custom CertStore to validate TLS pinning. Include a failing test when the server presents an unexpected SPKI hash and a passing test when it matches.
Add a Windows-only test that uses reqwest's default TLS backend to verify that our proxy environment variable parsing works with backslashes in paths. Provide a sample with set_var and cleanup.

Our SDK’s backpressure behavior is untested. Add tests to ensure the bounded channel between the request queue and workers drops tasks with a specific error when full, rather than blocking indefinitely. Include metrics and log assertions.

We want to verify that serde default values are applied during deserialization. Add tests covering missing optional fields, null vs absent, and unknown fields with deny_unknown_fields disabled. Use serde_json::from_str and assert exact error messages for malformed inputs.
